[P0] Webhook entry: several secrets, objects of other products ignored, log-only events (ST-3 part 1; MARKET_STRATEGY 5.1 "Webhook", "shared account" paragraph, event table)
CHANGE: server/src/roboapply/routes/stripeWebhook.ts: secretOf (today line 30) returns stripeWebhookSecrets(process.env) from server/src/platform/billing/stripeEnv.ts (MKT-1A: both variable names, comma-separated lists); constructEvent (line 42) is tried with each secret in order and the first that verifies wins; none -> 400 invalid_signature; an empty list -> 500 webhook_secret_missing as today; no Stripe client -> 503 as today. Keep answering 500 when processing fails. server/src/roboapply/services/RoboApplyBillingService.ts handleRoboApplyStripeEvent (today lines 984-1060): one guard per object kind, each answering { handled: false } (HTTP 200) for an object that is not ours: Checkout Sessions: metadata.product !== 'roboapply' (exists, line 990); a session whose metadata.brand is not roboapply stays ignored with the error log of lines 991-995 and keeps answering { handled: true } without reading anything from Stripe, exactly as today (rule A11; the parity wave's test 'A11 never activates anything for a GoApply-branded Stripe session' in integration/RoboApplyBillingService.stripe.test.ts pins that answer and stays unedited). Subscriptions: ours when a SeekerSubscription row already carries its id (legacy starter / growth subscriptions have no product metadata), or when metadata.product === 'roboapply' and metadata.brand !== 'goapply'. Invoices, charges and disputes: ours only when findBillingOwnerByCustomer(db, customer) (MKT-1A seam) finds a row. In every one of these guards a stored row whose brand is 'goapply' is never ours for Stripe: no Stripe event syncs it, activates it or rewrites its brand (today subscription and invoice events find their row by stripeSubscriptionId and write brand 'roboapply' without reading the row's brand: PAR-6 handoff, finding 10); answer { handled: false } and log one error line. No item of this bundle edits the Alipay callback route of routes/billing.ts or handleAlipayCallback in this service file (both files are owned here for the Stripe changes only). Add cases checkout.session.async_payment_failed and checkout.session.expired: for our sessions one info log and { handled: true }; nothing else. Keep the default branch's registry dispatch (MKT-1A seam) exactly as it is: charge.refunded and charge.dispute.created are registered by MKT-2D in this same phase and must NOT get a case in this switch.
ACCEPT: Two webhook secrets configured: an event signed with either verifies and one signed with a third answers 400; stripe trigger fixtures (objects of another product on a shared account) answer HTTP 200 with handled false for every event type of the table; a goapply-branded session activates nothing and still answers { handled: true } (the A11 test passes unedited); a subscription or invoice event whose stored row has brand goapply changes no row and answers handled false; async_payment_failed and expired change no row.
TESTS: server/src/platform/billing/integration/stripeWebhook.route.test.ts (two secrets, wrong secret, no secret; the SDK's constructEvent is stubbed on the fake client); server/src/platform/billing/integration/stripeWebhook.events.test.ts (new; createFakePrisma, fake Stripe via setStripeClientForTests / setBillingServiceDepsForTests): one "not ours" case per object kind and the two log-only events.
FILES: server/src/roboapply/routes/stripeWebhook.ts, server/src/roboapply/services/RoboApplyBillingService.ts, server/src/platform/billing/integration/stripeWebhook.route.test.ts, integration/stripeWebhook.events.test.ts

[P0] Subscription events: created attaches the id, every event re-reads the subscription, the plan comes from the price first, pending updates handled (ST-3 part 2; MARKET_STRATEGY 5.1 event table; PAY S4, S7, S8)
CHANGE: server/src/roboapply/services/RoboApplyBillingService.ts. (1) resolvePlanFromStripe (today lines 752-759): price first: planKeyForPrice(sub.items.data[0].price) (stripeCatalog, MKT-1A), then metadata.planKey / hints.planKey, then the legacy map. This fixes the portal bug: a price changed outside the app no longer keeps the old plan key, interval and practice allowance. (2) New case customer.subscription.created: only for our subscriptions (item 1); find the row by metadata.seekerProfileId; write stripeSubscriptionId (unique) and stripeCustomerId and sync state with credit mode 'none' (state only). With invoice.paid (billing_reason subscription_create, already handled on lines 1026-1050 with the period guard) this activates and grants once when checkout.session.completed never arrives. (3) Cases customer.subscription.updated, .deleted, .pending_update_applied, .pending_update_expired (today lines 1014-1025 handle the first two from the event snapshot): first const fresh = await stripe.subscriptions.retrieve(id), then upsertFromSubscription(fresh, …, 'none'), so a late older event cannot roll state back. upsertFromSubscription (lines 761-833) is otherwise unchanged; credits still come only from invoice.paid and never while past_due. (4) checkout.session.completed keeps its claim billing:checkout:<session> (line 1000); move its body into applyCheckoutSession(session, stripe) so item 3 can reuse it.
ACCEPT: (section 9) subscription.created + invoice.paid activates once when checkout.session.completed never arrives; a stale update does not roll back; a portal price change records the new plan. Added: the three events in any order grant the period's credits once; pending_update_applied records the new plan key, interval and amount; pending_update_expired leaves the old plan; a deleted subscription sets the row to free; re-read failures answer 500 so Stripe retries.
TESTS: server/src/platform/billing/integration/stripeWebhook.events.test.ts: every acceptance line as a test on the fake Prisma with a fake Stripe whose subscriptions.retrieve returns the "current" object while the event carries an older snapshot; integration/RoboApplyBillingService.stripe.test.ts: existing cases adapted to the retrieve call (they keep passing with pins).
FILES: server/src/roboapply/services/RoboApplyBillingService.ts, server/src/platform/billing/integration/stripeWebhook.events.test.ts, integration/RoboApplyBillingService.stripe.test.ts

[P0] Lost-event recovery for one-time payments: the return page reconciles the Checkout Session (ST-3 part 3; MARKET_STRATEGY 5.1 "Lost-event recovery", C3). The web half is MKT-2E.
CHANGE: server/src/roboapply/routes/billing.ts: new POST /checkout/reconcile (requireAuth), body { sessionId: string matching /^cs_[A-Za-z0-9_]{8,200}$/ } (zod, strict; 422 invalid_request otherwise). server/src/roboapply/services/RoboApplyBillingService.ts: reconcileCheckoutSession(userId, brand, sessionId): no Stripe client -> 503 stripe_not_configured; stripe.checkout.sessions.retrieve(sessionId); Stripe resource_missing -> 404 not_found; ownership: session.metadata.product === 'roboapply', session.metadata.brand is roboapply or absent, session.metadata.userId === userId, and, when the account already has a Stripe customer, session.customer equals it; any failure -> 403 forbidden with no detail; payment_status not 'paid' (and not 'no_payment_required') -> { status: 'pending' } without side effects; otherwise run applyCheckoutSession(session, stripe) from item 2, the same claimed fulfilment as the webhook (claim billing:checkout:<session>), so a later webhook is a duplicate and a repeated reconcile is a no-op. Rate limit 10 calls a minute per user (platform/ratelimit consumeRateLimit; 429 rate_limited). Contract (identical in MKT-2E): request { sessionId }; response { status: 'fulfilled' | 'already_fulfilled' | 'pending', mode: 'payment' | 'subscription', planKey: string | null }; errors 403 forbidden, 404 not_found, 422 invalid_request, 429 rate_limited, 503 stripe_not_configured, 502 payment_provider_error.
ACCEPT: (section 9) A paid pass whose webhook never arrives is fulfilled once by the reconcile call and a later webhook is a duplicate; another user's session id is refused. Added: a paid pack is granted once by reconcile + webhook in either order; an unpaid session answers pending and changes nothing; a subscription session reconciles through the same claim; a goapply-branded or foreign session is refused with 403; the route never returns Stripe's session object.
TESTS: server/src/roboapply/routes/billing.stripe.test.ts (new; route harness, fake Prisma, fake Stripe): the cases above; server/src/platform/billing/integration/stripeWebhook.events.test.ts: reconcile then webhook, webhook then reconcile. Do not edit server/src/roboapply/routes/billing.test.ts (the parity wave's Alipay rule tests live there).
FILES: server/src/roboapply/routes/billing.ts, server/src/roboapply/routes/billing.stripe.test.ts, server/src/roboapply/services/RoboApplyBillingService.ts, server/src/platform/billing/integration/stripeWebhook.events.test.ts

[P1] Mails the webhook owes: payment action required, and the cancel confirmation when the cancellation came from the portal (ST-3, ST-7; MARKET_STRATEGY 5.1 "Dunning and SCA", "Cancel and resume")
CHANGE: server/src/platform/email/templates/billing/index.ts: new transactional template billing.payment_action_required with params { planKey, amountMinor, currency, hostedInvoiceUrl } (heading, one paragraph, a button to the hosted invoice page, the usual footer); add it to BILLING_EMAIL_TEMPLATES (lines 274-281); English strings under billing.paymentActionRequired.* in server/src/i18n/email/staging/billing.en.json. server/src/roboapply/services/RoboApplyBillingService.ts: case invoice.payment_action_required: owner by customer (item 1); claim billing:payaction:<invoice.id> through claimBillingEvent; send once with invoice.hosted_invoice_url; no state change (past_due handling stays with invoice.payment_failed, lines 943-974). Portal cancellations: in the subscription.updated path, when the re-read subscription has cancel_at_period_end true, the row had cancelAtPeriodEnd false, and metadata.cancelSource is empty (our own cancel sets it, subscriptions.ts:252, and sends its own mail), claim billing:cancel:<subId>:<period end unix> and call sendCancelConfirmation (lines 466-483) once. Contract with MKT-2C: resumeSubscription clears metadata.cancelSource, so a later portal cancel is seen as coming from outside.
ACCEPT: invoice.payment_action_required mails once with the hosted link and a replay sends nothing; a cancellation made in the portal sends the confirmation once, a replay sends nothing, and a cancellation made in the app still sends exactly one mail; no mail is sent for an invoice whose customer we do not know.
TESTS: server/src/platform/email/templates/billing/billing.test.ts (the new template renders subject, body and link in English and falls back for other locales); server/src/platform/billing/integration/stripeWebhook.events.test.ts (send counts through the fake sendEmail dep).

[P1] Customer portal configuration created by code; payment-method-update flow (ST-7; MARKET_STRATEGY 5.1 "Portal", M-16). The banner is MKT-2E.
CHANGE: New server/src/platform/billing/stripePortal.ts: ensurePortalConfiguration(stripe, brand, env) -> configuration id. Desired configuration: business_profile { privacy_policy_url: <app origin>/legal/privacy, terms_of_service_url: <app origin>/legal/terms } (the legal pages are app/legal/[doc]; use the slugs that exist), features: invoice_history on; payment_method_update on; customer_update on with allowed_updates email, name, address, tax_id; subscription_cancel on with mode at_period_end and cancellation_reason enabled; subscription_update OFF (plan changes stay in the app so the renewal acknowledgement is always recorded); metadata { product: 'roboapply', configHash: first 16 hex of sha256 of the desired object }. Lookup: memory cache per Stripe client -> billingPortal.configurations.list({ active: true, limit: 100 }) and pick the one whose metadata.product is roboapply and whose configHash matches -> else billingPortal.configurations.create(desired, { idempotencyKey: 'portalcfg:<hash>' }). Never read or change the account's default configuration. server/src/roboapply/services/RoboApplyBillingService.ts createPortalSession (today lines 439-447) takes { flow?: 'payment_method_update' } and calls billingPortal.sessions.create({ customer, return_url, configuration, flow_data: { type: 'payment_method_update' } when asked }). server/src/roboapply/routes/billing.ts POST /portal (lines 201-208) parses the body { flow?: 'payment_method_update' } (zod, strict). STRIPE_BILLING_PORTAL_URL is read nowhere: say so in the handoff so the env example drops it. Contract (identical in MKT-2E): request { flow?: 'payment_method_update' }; response { url }; errors 409 no_customer, 503 stripe_not_configured, 502 payment_provider_error.
ACCEPT: (section 9) The configuration is created once and reused, with subscription update off and our privacy and terms URLs in business_profile. Added: a second call in the same process makes no Stripe call; a cold process finds the existing configuration by hash and creates nothing; a changed desired object creates a new configuration and leaves the old one; every portal session carries configuration; flow payment_method_update is passed through; a user without a Stripe customer gets 409 no_customer.
TESTS: server/src/platform/billing/stripePortal.test.ts (new; fake billingPortal.configurations.list / create and sessions.create); server/src/roboapply/routes/billing.stripe.test.ts (POST /portal with and without flow).
FILES: server/src/platform/billing/stripePortal.ts, stripePortal.test.ts, server/src/roboapply/services/RoboApplyBillingService.ts, server/src/roboapply/routes/billing.ts, server/src/roboapply/routes/billing.stripe.test.ts

[P0] POST /billing/switch passes "payment needs action" through instead of reporting a switch (ST-5 seam; MARKET_STRATEGY 5.1 "Switch"). The Stripe call is MKT-2C, the sheet is MKT-2E.
CHANGE: server/src/roboapply/services/RoboApplyBillingService.ts switchPlan (today lines 502-537) answers { switched: true, planKey } whatever confirmSwitch returns. MKT-2C changes confirmSwitch in this same phase so that its result may carry requiresAction: true and hostedInvoiceUrl. Make switchPlan ready for it without depending on that merge: add confirmSwitch (and quoteSwitch) to BillingServiceDeps (lines 98-116) with the platform functions as defaults, call deps.confirmSwitch, read the two optional fields through a local structural type ({ requiresAction?: boolean; hostedInvoiceUrl?: string | null }) and answer { switched: false, requiresAction: true, hostedInvoiceUrl: <value or null>, planKey } when requiresAction is true, else { switched: true, planKey } as today. The acknowledgement record and deps.invalidate stay where they are. The route POST /switch (routes/billing.ts lines 221-234) and SwitchBodySchema are unchanged. Contract (identical in MKT-2C and MKT-2E): POST /billing/switch with confirm -> { switched: true, planKey } | { switched: false, requiresAction: true, hostedInvoiceUrl: string | null, planKey }; without confirm -> { quote } as today.
ACCEPT: With a confirmSwitch that reports requiresAction the route answers switched false with the hosted invoice URL and HTTP 200; with today's result it answers exactly what it answers today; a quote request is unchanged.
TESTS: server/src/platform/billing/integration/RoboApplyBillingService.stripe.test.ts (inject deps.confirmSwitch through setBillingServiceDepsForTests: pending and paid results).
FILES: server/src/roboapply/services/RoboApplyBillingService.ts, server/src/platform/billing/integration/RoboApplyBillingService.stripe.test.ts

[P1] Read-only check of the webhook endpoint's enabled events (ST-3 part 4; MARKET_STRATEGY 5.1 "Endpoint health"). The admin route and panel are MKT-4B and MKT-4C.
CHANGE: New server/src/platform/billing/stripeHealth.ts: EXPECTED_STRIPE_EVENTS = the fourteen types of the event table (checkout.session.completed, .async_payment_succeeded, .async_payment_failed, .expired; customer.subscription.created, .updated, .deleted, .pending_update_applied, .pending_update_expired; invoice.paid, .payment_failed, .payment_action_required; charge.refunded; charge.dispute.created). A test asserts that every type in this list is handled by handleRoboApplyStripeEvent or has a registered handler slot (charge.refunded and charge.dispute.created are registered by MKT-2D in the same phase: the test treats those two as "registered elsewhere" by name). checkStripeWebhookEndpoint(stripe): webhookEndpoints.list({ limit: 100 }); pick the enabled endpoint whose url ends with /api/v1/roboapply/stripe/webhook; return { checked: true, url, missingEvents } ('*' in enabled_events means none missing); no such endpoint -> { checked: true, url: null, missingEvents: all, reason: 'not_found' }; a permission error from a restricted key -> { checked: false, reason: 'restricted_key' }; any other error -> { checked: false, reason: 'error' }. It never creates or edits an endpoint. Exported for MKT-4B by file path (index.ts belongs to MKT-2D in this phase).
ACCEPT: An endpoint missing invoice.payment_action_required is reported with exactly that event; an endpoint subscribed to '*' reports none; a restricted key reports checked false and never throws; no Stripe write call is made.
TESTS: server/src/platform/billing/stripeHealth.test.ts (new; fake webhookEndpoints.list).
FILES: server/src/platform/billing/stripeHealth.ts, stripeHealth.test.ts

[P1] The legacy ¥-pass renewal reminder links to GoApply for RMB and Alipay (AL-6 mail half; MARKET_STRATEGY 5.3 G12, M-18). The plan-sheet line is MKT-2E.
CHANGE: server/src/platform/email/templates/billing/index.ts renewalReminderEmail, the manual + legacy branch (today lines 112-125: old RoboApply Alipay monthly passes, starter / growth, which can no longer be bought in RMB on RoboApply): after the existing paragraph add one paragraph and a second button that opens the other brand's pricing page: URL = getBrand(t.brand.otherBrand).canonicalOrigin + '/pricing' from the brand registry (never a host written in the template), shown only when the recipient's brand is roboapply and the pass was paid in CNY (new optional param currency already exists on RenewalReminderParams). You can pay in RMB with Alipay on GoApply." Put the Chinese sentence for the locale sync in the handoff (在中国大陆？可在 GoApply 用支付宝以人民币付款。); do not edit server/src/i18n/email/zh.json. It is a link, never a redirect, and no account is moved between brands.

bundles.title: Subscription changes: switch with pending_if_incomplete, resume, idempotency keys, tax switch (server)
items:
[P0] A plan switch changes the plan only if the proration is paid (ST-5 server; MARKET_STRATEGY 5.1 "Switch", PAY S10). The sheet is MKT-2E.
CHANGE: server/src/platform/billing/subscriptions.ts confirmSwitch (today lines 358-391). The subscriptions.update call (lines 382-388) adds payment_behavior: 'pending_if_incomplete' and a second argument { idempotencyKey: 'switch:<subId>:<planKey>:<prorationDate>' }; it keeps items, proration_behavior 'always_invoice', proration_date, cancel_at_period_end false and metadata (the Stripe pending-updates reference allows metadata and cancel_at_period_end with this behaviour; check the parameter list against node_modules/stripe types before coding and record the result in the handoff). When the returned subscription carries pending_update: read the hosted page of the open invoice (latest_invoice id -> invoices.retrieve -> hosted_invoice_url) and return { planKey, stripeSubscriptionId, requiresAction: true, hostedInvoiceUrl }; otherwise return { planKey, stripeSubscriptionId, requiresAction: false }. The acknowledgement is still recorded before Stripe is asked to charge (line 381). Note for the reader: Stripe applies metadata at once even while the price is pending, which is why the webhook resolves the plan from the price first (MKT-2B). The legacy route POST /billing/switch and switchPlan in RoboApplyBillingService.ts belong to MKT-2B in this phase and are not edited here: MKT-2B makes switchPlan pass requiresAction and hostedInvoiceUrl through (it reads them as optional fields, so either merge order works). Keep the two field names exactly. Contract (identical in MKT-2B and MKT-2E): confirmSwitch returns { planKey, stripeSubscriptionId, requiresAction: boolean, hostedInvoiceUrl?: string | null }; POST /billing/switch with confirm -> { switched: true, planKey } | { switched: false, requiresAction: true, hostedInvoiceUrl: string | null, planKey }.
ACCEPT: (section 9) A declined proration leaves the plan unchanged and returns requiresAction. Added: a paid proration returns requiresAction false and the update call carries payment_behavior pending_if_incomplete and the idempotency key; confirming the same quote twice sends the same key; the quote amount still equals the charge (same proration_date); a TWD subscription still switches only to a TWD price.
TESTS: server/src/platform/billing/subscriptions.test.ts (fake Stripe whose subscriptions.update returns pending_update for the declined case; assertions on the parameters and the idempotency option).
FILES: server/src/platform/billing/subscriptions.ts, subscriptions.test.ts

[P0] Resume: "Keep my plan" turns renewal back on while the period is live (ST-6 server; MARKET_STRATEGY 5.1 "Cancel and resume", 4.4 "Cancel"). The button is MKT-2E.
CHANGE: server/src/platform/billing/subscriptions.ts: new resumeSubscription(account, deps, ack): allowed only when describePlan says the plan is live, the row has a stripeSubscriptionId, cancelAtPeriodEnd is true and the plan definition renews (a pass or a plan whose period ended has nothing to resume) -> otherwise BillingError('nothing_to_resume') (code added by MKT-1A); the unticked acknowledgement is required (auto_renew_ack_required otherwise) and is recorded through ack.record with the plan at the price and currency that is charged (row.amountMinor / row.currency) BEFORE the Stripe call; then stripe.subscriptions.update(id, { cancel_at_period_end: false, metadata: { cancelSource: '' } }, { idempotencyKey: 'resume:<subId>:<period end unix>' }) (the empty string clears our cancel marker so a later portal cancellation is recognised by MKT-2B); then the row gets cancelAtPeriodEnd false. cancelSubscription (lines 229-261): add { idempotencyKey: 'cancel:<subId>:<period end unix>' } to its update call (lines 242-253); nothing else changes. server/src/features/credits/routes.ts createCreditsRouter (lines 66-91): POST /resume; service.ts: CreditsAreaService.resume(userId, brand, body, { ip, userAgent }) using loadBillingAccount, resumeSubscription (imported by file path from platform/billing/subscriptions.js), recordCheckoutAcknowledgements and invalidateEntitlements; contract.ts: ResumeSubscriptionBodySchema = z.object({ autoRenewAck: z.literal(true) }).strict() and ResumeResponse. Contract (identical in MKT-2E): POST /api/v1/roboapply/credits/resume { autoRenewAck: true } -> { status: 'resumed', planKey: string, renewsAt: string | null }; errors 409 nothing_to_resume, 422 auto_renew_ack_required, 503 rail_not_configured, 502 payment_provider_error.
ACCEPT: (section 9) Resume turns renewal back on and records the acknowledgement; refused after the period ended and for a pass. Added: the consent record is an auto_renew_ack with the hash of the sentence naming the period and the price that is charged; a failed Stripe call leaves the row cancelled and answers 502; the entitlement cache is invalidated; a GoApply account gets nothing_to_resume; resuming twice sends one idempotency key and the second call answers nothing_to_resume.
TESTS: server/src/platform/billing/subscriptions.test.ts (resume rules, parameters, idempotency option, cancel idempotency option); server/src/features/credits/credits.test.ts (route: 200, 409, 422; acknowledgement row written before the Stripe call).
FILES: server/src/platform/billing/subscriptions.ts, subscriptions.test.ts, server/src/features/credits/routes.ts, service.ts, contract.ts, credits.test.ts

[P1] STRIPE_TAX_ENABLED switch, off by default (ST-8; MARKET_STRATEGY 5.1 "Tax", M-15)
CHANGE: server/src/platform/billing/rails/stripe.ts createCheckout: when parseBoolEnv(env.STRIPE_TAX_ENABLED) is true the session gets automatic_tax: { enabled: true }, tax_id_collection: { enabled: true } and billing_address_collection: 'required' (today 'auto', line 106); customer_update { address: 'auto', name: 'auto' } is already sent since MKT-1A (Stripe requires it with tax on an existing customer). Off: none of the three is sent and billing_address_collection stays 'auto'. server/src/platform/billing/subscriptions.ts quoteSwitch: with the switch on, invoices.createPreview gets automatic_tax: { enabled: true } so the quote includes tax; confirmSwitch passes automatic_tax on the update only if the pending-updates parameter list allows it together with pending_if_incomplete (check the SDK types; a subscription created through a tax-enabled Checkout Session already carries automatic tax); record what you found in the handoff. Prices are already created with tax_behavior inclusive (MKT-1A), so the shown price stays the charged price.
ACCEPT: (section 9) Off: no tax fields sent. On: automatic_tax, tax id collection and required address are sent. Added: with the switch on the switch quote asks for automatic tax; the default env sends exactly what MKT-1A sent.
TESTS: server/src/platform/billing/rails/stripe.tax.test.ts (new; fake Stripe, both states for a subscription and a one-time payment); server/src/platform/billing/subscriptions.test.ts (quote preview parameters in both states).
FILES: server/src/platform/billing/rails/stripe.ts, rails/stripe.tax.test.ts, subscriptions.ts, subscriptions.test.ts
env: STRIPE_TAX_ENABLED: true adds automatic tax, tax id collection and a required billing address to Checkout and automatic tax to switch quotes; needs Stripe Tax and registrations in the Dashboard (default unset = off)

bundles.title: Refund engine: issueRefund, charge.refunded, disputes, pro-rata withdrawal rule, withdrawPurchase, refund mails (server)
items:
[P0] issueRefund: ownership, payment intent lookup, Stripe idempotency key, one readable record (ST-4 part 1; MARKET_STRATEGY 5.1 "Refunds and disputes", 4.4 "How a refund is executed")
CHANGE: New server/src/platform/billing/stripeRefunds.ts. issueRefund({ userId, target: { invoiceId } | { checkoutSessionId }, amountMinor?, reason, actor, kind?: 'refund' | 'withdrawal' }, deps): load the billing account; no Stripe client -> rail_not_configured; retrieve the invoice or session and require its customer to equal the account's stripeCustomerId, else BillingError('refund_not_available'); payment intent: for a Checkout Session session.payment_intent; for an invoice stripe.invoicePayments.list({ invoice, limit: 10 }) and the paid payment's payment_intent (current invoices carry payments separately; fall back to a top-level payment_intent when the object has one); none -> refund_not_available; amountMinor, when given, must be a positive integer not above what is still refundable; stripe.refunds.create({ payment_intent, amount when partial, reason: 'requested_by_customer', metadata: { product: 'roboapply', userId, actor, kind, planKey } }, { idempotencyKey: 'refund:<pi>:<amount or full>' }); return { refundId, paymentIntentId, chargeId, amountMinor, currency, full }. issueRefund changes NO entitlement: access changes only in the charge.refunded webhook (item 2), so a refund made in the Stripe Dashboard behaves the same. Deps (db, getStripe, now, sendEmail, invalidate, adjustCredits, grantForPlan) are injectable; defaults import the real ones lazily. Import the module once from server/src/platform/billing/index.ts (this bundle owns index.ts in M2) so its event handlers register at boot; export issueRefund, withdrawPurchase and the types.
ACCEPT: A full refund of an invoice and of a one-time session each call refunds.create once with the right payment intent and idempotency key; a second identical call sends the same key; an invoice of another customer is refused with refund_not_available and no Stripe write; a partial amount is passed through; nothing in the database changes except what item 2 does on the webhook.
TESTS: server/src/platform/billing/stripeRefunds.test.ts (new; createFakePrisma + fake Stripe with invoices.retrieve, invoicePayments.list, checkout.sessions.retrieve, refunds.create; installed with setStripeClientForTests): the cases above. No test calls Stripe.

CHANGE: server/src/platform/billing/stripeRefunds.ts registers a handler for charge.refunded through registerStripeEventHandler (MKT-1A seam). Steps: (1) owner = findBillingOwnerByCustomer(db, charge.customer); none -> { handled: false } (HTTP 200: the account may be shared with other products). (2) claimBillingEvent(db, userId, 'refund:<charge.id>:<charge.amount_refunded>', 'stripe_refund'); not fresh -> { handled: true, duplicate: true }. (3) Find what was bought from charge.payment_intent: the payment intent's metadata (planKey, set at checkout for the pass and packs) and stripe.checkout.sessions.list({ payment_intent, limit: 1 }) for the session id; for a subscription charge stripe.invoicePayments.list filtered by the payment intent -> the invoice -> invoiceSubscriptionId -> the row. (4) Write one RABillingRefund row (schema below; unique on rail + externalRef '<charge.id>:<amount_refunded>'; kind 'refund', or 'withdrawal' when the refund's metadata.kind says so; full = charge.amount_refunded === charge.amount). (5) Only when full: a practice pack -> the RACreditGrant row packGrantId(userId, 'stripe:<sessionId>') (packs.ts): compute what is left of that pack with allocatePackRemaining, lower the practice balance by that amount through adjustCredits (lib/mockCreditService.ts:691) and set the grant's remaining to 0; the running pass -> subtract the pass length from currentPeriodEnd; if that is not after now, the row becomes tier free, planKey free, status canceled, currentPeriodEnd now, and the practice balance is re-granted at the Free allotment; a subscription invoice -> stripe.subscriptions.cancel(subId, {}, { idempotencyKey: 'refundcancel:<subId>:<charge.id>' }) (access then ends through customer.subscription.deleted) and the period's practice credits are reset to the Free allotment. (6) invalidate entitlements; send billing.refund_issued once (item 5). A partial refund does steps 1-4 and 6 without step 5. Every step is replay-safe; a failure answers 500 so Stripe retries.
ACCEPT: (section 9) Full refund of a pack / pass / subscription reverses the right thing once; replay is a no-op; a partial refund changes no access; a charge of a customer we do not know is ignored with HTTP 200. Added: a pack with 2 of 5 interviews used loses the remaining 3 and keeps nothing negative; a refunded pass stacked on another pass shortens access by one pass length instead of ending it; a refunded subscription invoice cancels the subscription now with the idempotency key; a second partial refund of the same charge (a new amount_refunded) is recorded as a new row; a refund made in the Dashboard (no metadata) is handled the same.
TESTS: server/src/platform/billing/integration/stripeRefunds.webhook.test.ts (new; events are passed to handleRoboApplyStripeEvent with the fake Prisma and a fake Stripe): one test per acceptance line, each replayed once.
FILES: server/src/platform/billing/stripeRefunds.ts, integration/stripeRefunds.webhook.test.ts

The row is the flag: MKT-4B lists disputes in the admin console. No mail to the user.
ACCEPT: A dispute on a pass, a pack or a subscription charge reverses the entitlement once and writes one dispute row; a replay changes nothing; a dispute on a charge of an unknown customer answers HTTP 200 handled false.

[P0] Withdrawal rule: full without the waiver, pro-rata for unused days with it, for subscriptions (ST-9 calculator; MARKET_STRATEGY M-21, 4.4 "Statutory withdrawal", C4)
CHANGE: server/src/platform/billing/refunds.ts computeRefund (today lines 100-153). RefundInput gains periodStart?: Date | null and periodEnd?: Date | null; RefundRule gains 'withdrawal_14d_prorata'; RefundDecision gains prorata: { usedDays: number; periodDays: number } | null and endsAccess: boolean. Rule 1 (lines 125-129) keeps the full refund within 14 days when the waiver was not ticked (first purchases and packs, never renewals). New rule 1b: region is set, the waiver WAS ticked, chargeKind is first_purchase, the plan is an auto-renewing subscription (pro_weekly, pro_monthly, pro_quarterly, student_monthly, student_quarterly) and now is within 14 days of the charge and before periodEnd: eligible with rule withdrawal_14d_prorata, periodDays = round((periodEnd - periodStart) / 1 day), usedDays = min(periodDays, ceil((now - periodStart) / 1 day)), amountMinor = floor(amount * (periodDays - usedDays) / periodDays). Without period bounds rule 1b does not apply (the old rules decide). A used pass and used practice credits keep today's rules (2-4). endsAccess is true for both withdrawal rules. Bump REFUND_POLICY_VERSION.roboapply to 'refund-v2-2026-10' (GoApply's version string is unchanged: its passes are outside this rule). server/src/platform/billing/acknowledgements.ts: export WITHDRAWAL_COUNTRIES (the EU 27 of lines 26-29 + IS, LI, NO of line 31 + GB + TW) as the one list the web mirrors (MKT-4C adds a test that keeps lib/pricing.ts equal to it); withdrawalRegion (36-43) is unchanged. CHANGE: server/src/platform/billing/stripeRefunds.ts: withdrawalQuote(userId, deps) and withdrawPurchase({ userId, purchaseId, actor }, deps). withdrawalQuote finds the user's latest paid Stripe charge the way refundQuote does today (server/src/features/credits/service.ts lines 747-854: the latest paid invoice of the customer; billing_reason subscription_cycle = renewal), reads the waiver consent near the charge time, the billing country on the row and, for a subscription, the period bounds from the Stripe subscription (stripePeriod), and returns { purchase: { source: 'stripe', id, planKey, chargedAt, amountMinor, currency }, decision } only when computeRefund answers rule withdrawal_14d or withdrawal_14d_prorata; otherwise null. withdrawPurchase re-computes the quote (purchaseId must match, else BillingError('withdrawal_not_available')), then: for a subscription stripe.subscriptions.cancel(subId, {}, { idempotencyKey: 'withdraw:<subId>' }) FIRST, so access ends through customer.subscription.deleted whatever amount is refunded; then issueRefund for decision.amountMinor with kind 'withdrawal' (the partial refund alone would change no access: this is the one partial refund that ends access); for a pass or pack a full issueRefund (entitlements reverse on charge.refunded). Send billing.withdrawal_confirmed (item 5) once (claim 'withdraw:<purchaseId>'). Return { status: 'withdrawn', refundMinor, currency, accessEnded: true, rule }. GoApply accounts and CN orders always get null / withdrawal_not_available (the rail has no refund call).
ACCEPT: A German subscriber with the waiver on day 5 of 30: the subscription is cancelled at once, 25/30 is refunded, Pro ends when the deleted event is processed, and one confirmation mail is sent; without the waiver the refund is full and the subscription is cancelled; calling twice sends the same two idempotency keys and refunds once; outside the 14 days the call is refused and nothing is cancelled; the cancel call always happens before the refund call.

FILES: server/src/platform/billing/stripeRefunds.ts, stripeRefunds.test.ts

[P1] Refund and withdrawal mails (ST-4, ST-9; MARKET_STRATEGY 5.1 event table "Reverse entitlements, mail")
CHANGE: New server/src/platform/email/templates/billing/refunds.ts (a separate file: templates/billing/index.ts belongs to MKT-2B in this phase), imported by stripeRefunds.ts so the templates register: billing.refund_issued { planKey, amountMinor, currency, full, accessEnded } (states the amount, that it goes back to the original payment method, and whether access changed) and billing.withdrawal_confirmed { planKey, amountMinor, currency, withdrawnAt } (the automatic confirmation the EU withdrawal function requires: what was withdrawn, when we received it, the refund amount, that the subscription ended). Both transactional, no unsubscribe link, amounts formatted with formatPrice from templates/billing/index.ts (import only). English strings in the new file server/src/i18n/email/staging/billingRefunds.en.json under { "billing": { "refundIssued": …, "withdrawalConfirmed": … } } (the loader merges every staging/*.en.json).
ACCEPT: Both templates render subject, body and amounts in English and fall back to English for locales without a translation; a full refund says access ended, a partial one does not claim it; no template names a competitor or promises a processing time we do not control.
TESTS: server/src/platform/email/templates/billing/refunds.test.ts (new).
FILES: server/src/platform/email/templates/billing/refunds.ts, refunds.test.ts, server/src/i18n/email/staging/billingRefunds.en.json, server/src/platform/billing/stripeRefunds.ts
schema:
model RABillingRefund (new, server/prisma/schema/ra-credits.prisma; additive; no relation fields so no existing model is edited):
/// One refund, withdrawal, dispute or manual CN refund (MARKET_STRATEGY ST-4, ST-9, AL-7). Idempotency stays on
/// RACreditLedger claims; this row is the readable record (history marker, admin list, dispute flag). Insert-only.
model RABillingRefund {
  id                  String   @id @default(cuid())
  userId              String
  brand               String   // 'roboapply' | 'goapply'
  rail                String   // 'stripe' | 'alipay' | 'wechatpay'
  kind                String   // 'refund' | 'withdrawal' | 'dispute' | 'manual_cn'
  /// Stripe: '<chargeId>:<amount_refunded>' or 'dispute:<disputeId>'; CN: 'order:<AlipayOrder.id>'
  externalRef         String
  chargeId            String?
  paymentIntentId     String?
  invoiceId           String?
  checkoutSessionId   String?
  alipayOrderId       String?
  planKey             String?
  amountMinor         Int
  currency            String
  full                Boolean  @default(false)
  entitlementReversed Boolean  @default(false)
  reason              String?
  /// Admin user id, 'self' (withdrawal) or 'stripe' (Dashboard refund, dispute)
  actor               String?
  note                String?  @db.Text
  createdAt           DateTime @default(now())

  @@unique([rail, externalRef])
  @@index([userId, createdAt(sort: Desc)])
  @@index([invoiceId])
  @@index([alipayOrderId])
  @@index([kind, createdAt])
}
Everything above is delivered by MKT-0 in phase M0 (see its schema array for the exact Prisma text); this bundle never edits *.prisma and never runs a push.

items:

Do NOT add a documented wrapper to lib/api/credits.ts and do not import a new type from lib/api/contracts/credits.ts for a route another bundle adds in this phase: the mount-table test and the web type-check would fail in this worktree. A 403 or 404 stops further reconcile calls and leaves the existing waiting / slow copy; a 'pending' answer keeps polling. lib/api/account.ts: reconcileCheckout(sessionId). Contract (identical in MKT-2B): POST /api/v1/roboapply/billing/checkout/reconcile { sessionId } -> { status: 'fulfilled' | 'already_fulfilled' | 'pending', mode: 'payment' | 'subscription', planKey: string | null }; errors 403 forbidden, 404 not_found, 422 invalid_request, 429 rate_limited, 503 stripe_not_configured, 502 payment_provider_error. GoApply pages never call it.

bundles.title: Canonical skill vocabulary: table access, aliases in three scripts, related-evidence graph, seed and review tooling (SM-6, foundation)
items:
[P0] Vocabulary module: ids, alias keys, lookup, and a snapshot that is always loaded before it is used (SM-6; strategy 2.1 point 2, 2.5 row "Skills"; MATCH 4.6)
CHANGE: New server/src/features/skills/ (no consumer is changed in this bundle). types.ts: SkillRecord { id, kind: hard | soft | certification, labelEn, labelZh, labelZhHant, aliases, parentId, esco, onet, status: reviewed | unreviewed } and the interface SkillVocabulary { idOf(term: string): string | null; kindOf(id): SkillRecord["kind"] | null; reviewed(id): boolean; label(id, locale: string): string; parentOf(id): string | null; childrenOf(id): string[]; size: number }. keys.ts: aliasKey(term) = the termKey of server/src/features/match/terms.ts (NFKC, lower case, singular, no spaces or punctuation), extended for CJK by folding Traditional to Simplified with foldTwToCn (features/jobs/normalize/zhVariants.ts), so 機器學習, 机器学习 and "machine learning" can be aliases of one id. vocabulary.ts: buildVocabulary(records) (pure, used by tests and by the seed) and loadVocabulary(): reads RASkill through an injected repo, merges it over the committed seed (seed/skills.seed.json, next item), caches for 10 minutes and exposes ready(): Promise<void> and current(): SkillVocabulary; current() before the first load returns the seed-only vocabulary, never an empty one. repo.ts: typed Prisma reads and upserts of the scalar columns (the embedding column is written with $executeRaw in canonicalize.ts). index.ts exports the types, ready, current, canonicalize (next items) and nothing that opens a database on import. label(id, locale): en -> labelEn; zh -> labelZh, else labelEn; zh-TW -> labelZhHant, else labelEn (never the Simplified label for Taiwan).
ACCEPT: idOf("Node.js"), idOf("nodejs") and idOf("NodeJS") give one id; idOf of a string the vocabulary does not know is null; label(id, "zh-TW") never returns a Simplified-only label; importing the module opens no database connection; current() is usable synchronously after ready() and returns the seed before it.
TESTS: server/src/features/skills/vocabulary.test.ts and keys.test.ts with an in-memory repo: alias folding in three scripts, label fallbacks, seed-only before load, merge of database rows over the seed, cache expiry.
FILES: server/src/features/skills/types.ts, keys.ts, vocabulary.ts, repo.ts, index.ts and their tests

[P0] Seed from what the repository already knows; the related-evidence graph (SM-6; MATCH 4.6 (seed from our own data first), 2.5 (certificates as first-class skills); D3)
CHANGE: New server/src/features/skills/seed/skills.seed.json and seed/build.ts (deterministic generator). Sources, all already in the repository or common public knowledge of tool names: (1) server/src/features/match/terms.ts: export the two private tables SHOWN_BY (line 100) and EVERYDAY_WORDS (line 73) without changing them or any behaviour (the only edit of that file); SHOWN_BY (which named technology shows which broader term) becomes parentId edges (postgresql -> relational_databases, aws -> cloud_infrastructure, rest api -> api_design), displayTerm (line 261) gives the canonical English spelling (Go, MySQL, gRPC, Node.js), EVERYDAY_WORDS marks names that are also ordinary words (kept as a flag everydayWord on the seed entry, used by the keyword check later); (2) server/src/features/search/skills.ts SKILL_ALIASES (line 27): alias keys (k8s -> kubernetes, js -> javascript); (3) soft skills seen as "skills" in postings (communication, attention to detail, teamwork, leadership, problem solving and their Chinese forms 沟通能力, 团队合作, 责任心) as kind soft; (4) certificates common in postings as kind certification with their usual names in the three scripts: CPA / 注册会计师, 教师资格证, 一级建造师 (一建), CET-6 / 大学英语六级, 普通话等级证书, PMP, CFA. Every seed entry has status reviewed, esco and onet null (no identifier is invented; they are attached only by the import of the next item), and Chinese labels only where the engineer is certain of the standard term; otherwise labelZh / labelZhHant stay null. related.ts: evidenceFor(skillId, haveIds: ReadonlySet<string>): 'shown' when haveIds has the id; 'related' when haveIds has a descendant of it (a more specific skill shows the broader one: PostgreSQL for relational databases) with via = that descendant; never the other way round (a broader skill on the resume does not show the specific one); else 'not_shown'. Sibling skills are not related evidence.
ACCEPT: The seed builds byte-identically twice; it has no duplicate id and no alias key pointing at two ids; evidenceFor(relational_databases, {postgresql}) is related via postgresql; evidenceFor(postgresql, {relational_databases}) is not_shown; every pair of terms.ts SHOWN_BY is represented and the existing terms.test.ts passes unchanged.
TESTS: server/src/features/skills/seed.test.ts (shape, uniqueness, determinism, coverage of the terms.ts tables read at test time), related.test.ts (the three states, direction, siblings).
FILES: server/src/features/skills/seed/, server/src/features/skills/related.ts and their tests, server/src/features/match/terms.ts (two exports added)

[P0] canonicalize(): exact alias, then a strict embedding neighbour, else a new unreviewed skill (SM-6; MATCH 4.6 write path)
CHANGE: New server/src/features/skills/canonicalize.ts: canonicalize(term, deps?: { embed?: (texts: string[]) => Promise<number[][] | null>; nearest?: (vector, limit) => Promise<Array<{ id, cosine }>>; create?: (record) => Promise<void> }) -> { skillId, status: reviewed | unreviewed, via: 'alias' | 'embedding' | 'new' | 'none' }. Order: (1) vocabulary.idOf(term); (2) only when deps.embed and deps.nearest are given and the term is at least 2 characters and not an everyday word: embed the term, take the nearest canonical skill by cosine over RASkill.embedding (raw SQL: ORDER BY embedding <=> $1::halfvec LIMIT 3, restricted to rows whose embeddingModel equals the current model) and accept it only at cosine >= SKILL_EMBED_MATCH_MIN (default 0.86) AND when the second neighbour is at least 0.03 below the first; an accepted match also stores the term's alias key on that skill so the next lookup is exact; (3) otherwise, when deps.create is given, insert a new RASkill with status unreviewed, kind hard, labelEn = the term in display form, mentionCount 1 (an unreviewed skill is shown on cards and is never scored); (4) with no deps the result is { skillId: null, via: 'none' }. canonicalizeMany(terms) batches the embedding call. No default wiring to an embeddings client here: the embeddings client is built in parallel (MKT-2H) and the enrichment bundle of phase M4 (MKT-4D) passes embed and nearest in. userSkillIds(skills: string[], resumeText: string): the ids of a person's listed skills plus every reviewed skill one of whose aliases appears as a whole word in the resume text (reuse mentions() of features/match/preScore.ts; an everyday-word alias counts only from the skill list, the rule terms.ts already applies).
ACCEPT: An exact alias never calls embed; a term with a neighbour at 0.9 and a runner-up at 0.7 maps to it and learns the alias; a neighbour at 0.84 does not map and a new unreviewed skill is created; without an embed function nothing is embedded and nothing fails; userSkillIds finds "PostgreSQL" in the sentence "tuned PostgreSQL queries" and does not find REST in "the rest of the migration".
TESTS: server/src/features/skills/canonicalize.test.ts with fake embed, nearest and create functions (no network, no database): each branch, the margin rule, alias learning, batching, userSkillIds cases in English and Chinese.
FILES: server/src/features/skills/canonicalize.ts, server/src/features/skills/canonicalize.test.ts, server/src/features/skills/index.ts

[P1] Owner tooling: mine our own skill strings, propose clusters, review by CSV, attach ESCO and O*NET ids from files (SM-6; MATCH 4.6 (cluster the 7,397 distinct strings, review the top 1,000 by hand), 8 decision 6; D3)
CHANGE: New server/src/features/skills/cli.ts (tsx server/src/features/skills/cli.ts <command>), every command a dry run unless --apply: export-strings --market: read-only count of distinct RAJob.skills / skillsDetail strings with their mention counts into a local file (owner-run; the engineer does not run it against a database); propose: deterministic clustering of those strings by alias key, by the terms.ts rules (termParts, dedupeTerms) and by edit distance <= 1 on keys of 6+ characters, writing clusters.csv (cluster id, suggested canonical label = most frequent spelling, members, total mentions, proposed kind); propose --with-model additionally asks the configured model to name each of the top N clusters and to propose aliases and Chinese labels (model call mocked in tests; output marked proposed, never written to RASkill without review); review-export --top 1000 and review-import <csv>: the reviewed CSV (id, kind, labelEn, labelZh, labelZhHant, aliases, parentId, decision keep | merge-into | drop) is upserted with status reviewed; attach-ids --esco <file> --onet <file>: sets esco / onet only where a label of the local file equals a label or alias exactly (case-insensitive); the files are supplied by the owner after approving those sources, none is downloaded by the code and no Lightcast data is read; embed-labels: writes RASkill.embedding for rows lacking one, through an injected embed function (wired in phase M4), in batches; export-seed: writes the reviewed rows back to seed/skills.seed.json so a fresh environment starts with them.
ACCEPT: Each command prints what it would write and writes nothing without --apply; review-import refuses a CSV that would make one alias key point at two ids; attach-ids writes no identifier that is not in the supplied file; no command opens the network.
TESTS: server/src/features/skills/cli.test.ts with an in-memory repo and fixture CSV files: clustering determinism, the alias-collision refusal, attach-ids exact-match rule, dry run writes nothing, export-seed round trip.
FILES: server/src/features/skills/cli.ts, server/src/features/skills/cluster.ts, server/src/features/skills/cli.test.ts, server/src/features/skills/__fixtures__/

bundles.title: Search document and embeddings write path: embeddings client, CJK segmentation, searchDoc / searchTsv, job and user vectors, sweep; relevance seam (SM-7 foundation, SM-11)
items:
[P0] Embeddings client on the OpenAI-compatible /embeddings endpoint; no key means the dense leg is off, never an error and never a fake vector (SM-7, SM-11; strategy M-10, 2.3 stack constraints, 2.5 row "Embedding"; critic C11)
CHANGE: LLMService has no embeddings call. New server/src/platform/embeddings/client.ts: resolveEmbeddingConfig(brand, env) through brandEnv (CN_<NAME> optional override, else the shared value: D5) -> { model, apiKey, baseUrl, batchSize, dimensions: 1024, modelTag } where modelTag is "<model>@1024" (the value stored in RAJobEmbedding.model) or null when no key is set; with EMBED_API_KEY and OPENAI_API_KEY both unset the client is unavailable. embedTexts(brand, texts, { purpose: 'job' | 'user' | 'query' | 'skill', carriesUserData: boolean, userId?, requestId? }) -> { vectors: number[][], model, tokens } | { unavailable: reason }: POST <baseUrl>/embeddings with { model (provider prefix such as openai/ stripped for the direct endpoint, the same rule OpenAIProvider applies), input: batch, dimensions: 1024 }, batches of at most EMBED_BATCH_SIZE (cap 96), one retry on 429 or 5xx with the Retry-After delay, timeout 20 s; every returned vector must have exactly 1024 finite numbers, otherwise the whole call fails (never padded, truncated or zero-filled). Policy before any request that carries user data (purpose user or query): the brand LLM route policy of server/src/platform/llm/brandPolicy.ts and the egress check of server/src/platform/llm/egressPolicy.ts, exactly as chat calls do: under CN_LLM_DOMESTIC_ONLY or CN_RESIDENCY_STRICT a GoApply call to a non-mainland endpoint returns unavailable (reason policy), so no user text leaves and retrieval runs without the dense leg. Daily budget per brand through consumeRateLimit (key budget:embed:<brand>, EMBED_DAILY_TOKENS); over budget -> unavailable (reason budget). Cost: tokens from the response usage field are written through the existing usage log (the writeDeductionLog path the enrichment and scorer cost logs use, sku ra_embed, units = tokens); server/src/lib/modelPricing.ts gets a row for the default model ONLY with a price the engineer reads on the vendor's own pricing page that day, with the URL and date in the row comment, and docs/LLM_COSTS.md is regenerated (npm run llm:costs) so npm run check:llm-costs stays green; if the price cannot be read, no row is added, tokens are still logged and the cost is recorded as unknown (D3: no assumed price). setEmbeddingsClientForTests(fake) is the only test seam.
ACCEPT: With no key: resolveEmbeddingConfig returns modelTag null and embedTexts returns { unavailable: 'no_key' } without any request. With a key and a mocked fetch: 200 inputs become 3 requests (96 + 96 + 8), each carrying dimensions 1024; a response with a 1536-long vector fails the call; a GoApply user-data call under CN_LLM_DOMESTIC_ONLY to the shared endpoint makes no request; CN_EMBED_MODEL set -> GoApply uses it and RoboApply does not; the token count reaches the usage log once per call.
TESTS: server/src/platform/embeddings/client.test.ts with a mocked fetch (no network): config resolution and brand fallback, batching, the dimension check, retry, policy refusal, budget, cost log call, the unavailable reasons.
FILES: server/src/platform/embeddings/client.ts, server/src/platform/embeddings/index.ts, server/src/platform/embeddings/client.test.ts, server/src/lib/modelPricing.ts, docs/LLM_COSTS.md

[P0] CJK segmentation, language of a posting and the lexical document (SM-11 (Accepted when: 产品 经理 segments consistently at ingest and query), SM-7; strategy 2.1 point 3, 2.5 row "Lexical tokens"; MATCH 2.3 consequence, 4.9)
CHANGE: New server/src/features/retrieval/segment.ts: segmentForSearch(text): string[] used for BOTH documents and queries (one function, so the two sides always agree): NFKC, lower case; Latin and digits split on non-letters keeping tech tokens (c++, c#, .net, node.js as the title normaliser of taxonomy/match.ts spells them); Han runs go through Intl.Segmenter('zh', { granularity: 'word' }) (already used in jobs/enrich/keywords.ts), a segment longer than 4 characters or not word-like additionally yields its character bigrams (the fallback for unknown words), and every Han token is folded Traditional -> Simplified for this token copy only. Folding: new retrieval/hantHans.ts with a table generated by a small script (retrieval/buildHantHans.ts) from the Unicode Unihan kSimplifiedVariant data, committed with the Unicode version in its header; on top of it the vocabulary terms of features/jobs/normalize/zhVariants.ts foldTwToCn (軟體 -> 软件, 資料 -> 数据). If the engineer cannot obtain the Unihan file, use foldTwToCn alone and say so in the handoff; never hand-type a large table from memory. toTsQuery(text): the OR of the distinct tokens, each quoted for to_tsquery('simple', …) (the strategy's rule: the lexical query is the OR of the segmented tokens ranked by ts_rank_cd), at most 24 tokens. retrieval/lang.ts detectLang(text): 'zh-Hant' when Han characters dominate and at least 2% of them are Traditional-only (present as keys of the fold table), 'zh-Hans' for other Han-dominant text, 'ja' with kana, 'ko' with Hangul, 'en' for Latin text, else 'other'; it never guesses among European languages. retrieval/searchDoc.ts buildSearchDoc(job): the space-joined tokens of, in order: title; the role labels of primaryTaxonomyId in en and zh (and the zh-TW label when one exists); the level; the skills, required first (canonical labels and aliases through the vocabulary when RAJob.skillIds is filled, else the stored display strings; soft skills left out); the enrichment summary; the first 1,200 characters of the requirement text (qualifications, else descriptionPlain); capped at 4,000 characters. Company boilerplate, benefits and legal text are not included. Nothing here is ever displayed (zh-TW must never show Simplified text; this is a search copy).
ACCEPT: segmentForSearch("产品经理") and segmentForSearch("产品 经理") give the same tokens, and the query "產品經理" gives the same tokens as the document "产品经理"; "Senior C++ Engineer (Node.js)" keeps cpp and nodejs as tokens; toTsQuery("产品经理 Rust") is an OR of its tokens; detectLang separates a Traditional from a Simplified posting; buildSearchDoc of a posting contains the title tokens, both role labels and the required skills and none of the benefits text.
TESTS: server/src/features/retrieval/segment.test.ts (ingest and query agree, bigram fallback, folding, tech tokens, the 24-token cap), lang.test.ts, searchDoc.test.ts (order, caps, soft skills excluded, no benefits).
FILES: server/src/features/retrieval/segment.ts, hantHans.ts, buildHantHans.ts, lang.ts, searchDoc.ts and their tests

[P0] job.index worker: searchDoc and searchTsv in one statement, contentHash, lang, then the job vector (SM-7; strategy 2.3 step 6 and stack constraints (time budget; application-written tsvector); MATCH 4.9 write path)
CHANGE: New server/src/features/retrieval/repo.ts (raw SQL only for the Unsupported columns): writeSearchDoc(jobId, { searchDoc, contentHash, lang }) = one statement UPDATE "RAJob" SET "searchDoc" = $1, "searchTsv" = to_tsvector('simple', $1), "contentHash" = $2, "lang" = $3 WHERE "id" = $4 (searchDoc and searchTsv are never written apart); upsertJobEmbedding(jobId, market, model, contentHash, vector) = INSERT … ON CONFLICT ("jobId") DO UPDATE with the vector passed as a text literal cast ::halfvec(1024); jobsNeedingIndex(market, modelTag, limit) = live canonical rows (archivedAt null, closedAt null) with searchDoc null, or with no RAJobEmbedding row, or whose embedding row has another model or contentHash, newest firstSeenAt first; nearestJobsByJob(jobId, { market, country, modelTag, limit }) = public, canonical, open rows of the same market (and country when given) other than the job itself, ordered by e."embedding" <=> (SELECT "embedding" FROM "RAJobEmbedding" WHERE "jobId" = $1 AND "model" = $tag), exact, returning ids and distances (empty when the job has no vector); it is the read the Similar jobs list uses (MKT-2F in this same phase, through the feed seam similarJobIds). retrieval/index.ts exports these functions, userVector (next item) and currentModelTag(market) (the tag queries must filter on; item 5 defines when it switches). New retrieval/cardText.ts: the text that is embedded for a job, at most about 500 tokens (2,000 characters): title; role labels (en and zh); level; required skills then preferred (canonical labels when ids exist); the two-sentence summary; the first 1,200 characters of requirements; its sha1 is RAJobEmbedding.contentHash. New retrieval/workers.ts: work kind job.index, payload { jobIds: string[] } (1 to 96 ids): for each job load the columns, compute contentHash with jobContentHash of server/src/features/match/jobHash.ts (one definition of "the content a fit depends on"), build and write the search document (always: it needs no model), then embed all card texts of the item in one embedTexts call with purpose job and write the vectors; when the client is unavailable (no key, budget, policy) the item still succeeds with the lexical part written and the vectors left for the sweep; a job whose stored embedding already has this model and card hash is skipped. A user's private import is indexed lexically always, and embedded only when aiAllowed(owner) holds (its text came from the user; the same rule enrichment applies, enrich/service.ts line 194). Hook: server/src/features/jobs/enrich/service.ts runHooks (line 113, reached after an enriched and after a rules-only finish) gets a new EnrichDeps member enqueueIndex(jobId) -> enqueue('job.index', { jobIds: [jobId] }, { dedupeKey: "job.index:<jobId>:<enrichedAt ms>", brand }). Registration without touching the queue registry: server/src/features/jobs/enrich/workers.ts exports workers = [jobEnrichWorker, ...retrievalWorkers] (platform/queue/registry.ts already imports that array, line 12). Budgets: concurrency 4, one HTTP call per item, so no drain run embeds more than it can finish in its 240 s budget.
ACCEPT: After a job is enriched, a job.index item exists once; running it writes searchDoc, a non-null searchTsv, contentHash and lang in one UPDATE (the fake db sees exactly one statement for the four columns) and one RAJobEmbedding row with the current modelTag; with no embedding key the lexical columns are written and no embedding row and no error; a second run with unchanged content makes no embeddings call; an import of a user without the AI consent gets no vector.
TESTS: server/src/features/retrieval/workers.test.ts and repo.test.ts with a fake db that records SQL and parameters and a fake embeddings client: the single-statement write, upsert shape and the ::halfvec cast, skip rule, batch of 96 in one call, unavailable client path, consent rule for imports; jobs/enrich/service.test.ts (the hook is called after enriched and rules-only finishes), workers.test.ts (the kinds are registered).
FILES: server/src/features/retrieval/repo.ts, cardText.ts, workers.ts, index.ts and tests; server/src/features/jobs/enrich/service.ts, service.test.ts, workers.ts, workers.test.ts

[P0] User vectors (intent and resume) with the consent rules of each brand (SM-7; strategy 2.5 rows "Embedding" and "Consent"; MATCH 4.9 (what is embedded for a user), 2.5 cold start)
CHANGE: New server/src/features/retrieval/userText.ts: intentText(user) = target titles and role labels of the default search profile, level, top skills, chosen industries and the free-text goal from onboarding (exists before any resume: the cold-start vector); resumeText(user, resume) = the last two titles with their bullet text, the skills and the summary of the PRIMARY resume, after stripResumeForScoring (features/match/pii.ts: names, contact details and sensitive lines removed; school tier, photo, 籍贯, 政治面貌, gender and birth date are never part of it). Work kind user.embed, payload { userId, market }: builds both texts, skips a kind whose sourceHash (sha1 of the text + modelTag) equals the stored one, embeds with purpose user and carriesUserData true, and upserts RAUserEmbedding (userId, market, kind) with raw SQL. Gates, checked inside the worker: RoboApply: none beyond the account existing; GoApply: aiAllowed(userId) AND a live 个性化推荐 grant (hasLiveConsent(userId, 'personalized_recommendation'), the feed's own rule in feed/defaultService.ts), and the brand policy of item 1; when a gate fails the worker DELETES the user's rows for that market (no vector outlives a withdrawn consent). repo.ts: upsertUserEmbedding, deleteUserEmbeddings(userId, market), userVector(userId, market, modelTag) returning the resume vector, else the intent vector, else null, only for the current modelTag (vectors of another model are never compared). Vectors never cross markets: every statement filters on market.
ACCEPT: A RoboApply user with a primary resume gets two rows; without a resume only intent; a GoApply user without the AI consent or without 个性化推荐 gets none and existing rows are deleted on the next run; changing nothing makes no embeddings call; the text sent holds no name, e-mail or phone number from the resume fixture.
TESTS: server/src/features/retrieval/userText.test.ts (content, PII strip on the testkit resume, hash stability), workers.test.ts (the gates per brand, deletion on withdrawal, skip on equal hash, model tag filter in userVector). Fake client, fake consent functions, fake db.
FILES: server/src/features/retrieval/userText.ts, workers.ts, repo.ts and their tests

[P1] Sweep and backfill inside the existing score-precompute cron; a dry-run CLI for the first fill (SM-7; strategy 2.3 stack constraints (queued workers drained by queue-drain); MATCH 4.9)
CHANGE: New server/src/features/retrieval/sweep.ts runRetrievalSweep(ctx): per brand market, inside the cron's remaining time: (1) jobsNeedingIndex(market, modelTag, 960) -> enqueue job.index items of 96 ids each with dedupe key "job.index.batch:<sha1 of ids + modelTag>" (at most 10 items a run, so a model change re-embeds the market gradually and old vectors keep serving until replaced: queries filter on the model tag, so a market switches to the new model only when the share of live rows embedded with it passes 90%; until then the previous tag stays the query tag, stored in AppConfig key retrieval.modelTag.<market>); (2) users active in the last 7 days (match repo activeUsers) whose resume hash or search-profile version changed since their vector -> enqueue user.embed (dedupe by user and hashes); (3) delete RAUserEmbedding rows of GoApply users without a live grant. server/src/features/match/cron.ts: the composed score-precompute task of MKT-1F (precompute, then calibration) gets a third step runRetrievalSweep, last, skipped when ctx.budget.exhausted; no new cron entry and no edit of server/src/cron/handlers.ts or vercel.json. New retrieval/cli.ts (tsx server/src/features/retrieval/cli.ts backfill --market intl|cn [--apply] [--limit n]): prints how many rows lack a search document or a vector and the token estimate (characters / 4, labelled an estimate), and with --apply only enqueues the items; the engineer does not run it against a database.
ACCEPT: One cron run enqueues at most 10 batch items per market and nothing when every live row is indexed with the current model; a model change does not empty the dense leg (the query tag flips only past 90% coverage); the sweep runs after precompute and calibration and is skipped when the time budget is gone; the CLI without --apply writes nothing.
TESTS: server/src/features/retrieval/sweep.test.ts (limits, dedupe keys, the 90% switch rule, consent deletion) and match/cron.test.ts (third step order and skip) with fakes; cli.test.ts (dry run).
FILES: server/src/features/retrieval/sweep.ts, cli.ts and tests; server/src/features/match/cron.ts, server/src/features/match/cron.test.ts

[P1] Relevance seam, accepted end to end and not yet used for ordering (SM-9, SM-7 (so phase M4 can build retrieval, the planner and the search surfaces in parallel); MATCH 4.10)
CHANGE: server/src/features/feed/contract.ts: FeedQueryBodySchema and the preview input gain relevance: optional string, trimmed, at most 240 characters (free text that may influence ORDER only and is never a filter); NlQueryResponse (line 251) gains rankedBy: string[]. server/src/features/feed/FeedQueryService.ts: FeedQueryInput.relevance is accepted, included in queryHash (line 466) and carried on QueryState; preview() (line 880) and the index read function the job-search area uses on GoApply (added by PAR-8 to the feed seam in feed/index.ts) accept the same field; nothing reads it for ordering in this bundle. nlQuery (lines 780-796) returns rankedBy from planToFilters and keeps explanation and unmatched as they are. server/src/features/feed/filterDiff.ts: PlannerPlan gains optional relevanceTerms: string[]; planToFilters (line 229) returns { patch, unmatched, rankedBy } where rankedBy = the plan's relevanceTerms when present, else the unmatched phrases that are not constraints (a phrase about pay, visa, benefits, hours, time zone or commute stays in unmatched only: it is a requirement nobody checked, not a topic to rank by), each at most 60 characters, at most 5. feed/routes.ts passes the field through. server/src/features/feed/index.ts also exports similarJobIds(row, limit): currentModelTag(row.market) then nearestJobsByJob(row.id, { market: row.market, country: row.locationCountry, modelTag, limit }) of features/retrieval, returning the ids in distance order, or null when the market has no model tag, the job has no vector or the read fails; a private job of another user is never an anchor (the caller passes the viewer's own row only); the job-detail bundle of this phase (MKT-2F) calls it through the feed seam. No web change and no change of order in this bundle.
ACCEPT: POST /feed/query with relevance "climate startups Rust" returns the same order as without it (this phase) and a different session hash; POST /feed/nl-query for "backend jobs at climate startups using Rust, salary above 150k" returns rankedBy ["climate startups", "Rust"] (or the planner's own terms) and keeps the pay phrase out of rankedBy; relevance longer than 240 characters is refused with invalid_request; existing clients that do not send the field are unaffected; similarJobIds returns the fake repo's ids in order and null when there is no vector.
TESTS: server/src/features/feed/filterDiff.test.ts (rankedBy rules, constraint phrases excluded, caps), FeedQueryService.test.ts (hash includes relevance, order unchanged, nlQuery returns rankedBy), routes.test.ts (validation).

New server/src/features/feed/rankingText.ts: move the published texts of RANKING_FACTORS (the what strings, lines 345-350), ORDERING_RULES (lines 357-370) and GOAL_ADJUSTMENTS there without changing a word, a weight or a number; contract.ts keeps exporting the same three names by re-export, so every importer and the web mirror (components/features/marketing/catalog.ts) are untouched. rankingText.ts also exports FRESHNESS_CURVE = { fastHours: 48, slowHours: 336, fastShare: 0.7 } (not read yet; FEED_LIMITS.freshnessHalfLifeHours stays the value in use) so the ranking change of phase M4 edits rankingText.ts and ranking.ts and then deletes the old constant. server/src/features/feed/sql.ts: export the q predicate as its own function qPredicateSql(q) (the body of case 'q' in predicateFor, lines 272-276, unchanged) so the hybrid legs of phase M4 can reuse it. EMBED_BATCH_SIZE: inputs per request, at most 96 (96)
CN_EMBED_MODEL: optional GoApply override of EMBED_MODEL (unset -> the shared value; recommended by the strategy: Alibaba text-embedding-v4 in the Beijing region)
