bundles.title: Ingest core: monthly quota from response headers, one budget per provider, JSearch as a demand-only source
items:
[P0] Monthly quota read from every RapidAPI response and stored in AppConfig (JI-1; strategy 1.1, 1.2; INTL note 8.1 M1)
CHANGE: New server/src/features/jobs/ingest/quota.ts on top of MKT-1C's quotaContract.ts. (1) Capture: server/src/roboapply/v2/lib/raRapidApiJobs.ts already reads x-ratelimit-requests-limit / -remaining / -reset after a response (510-512) and decides monthly 429s in isMonthlyQuota429 (378-381); server/src/roboapply/v2/lib/raFantasticJobs.ts reads the same two request headers (596-597). Both clients export setQuotaListener(listener | null) and call it once per upstream response (success, 429, 401, 403; not for cache hits) with { provider: 'jsearch' | 'activejobs' | 'linkedin', status, requestsLimit, requestsRemaining, resetSeconds, jobsLimit, jobsRemaining (x-ratelimit-jobs-limit / x-ratelimit-jobs-remaining when the response carries them, else null), plan (the token after 'current plan,' in a 429 body such as '…on your current plan, BASIC', else null), at }. A listener that throws is swallowed; the key is never passed. (2) quota.ts keeps the latest snapshot per provider in memory, derives state (429 with remaining 0 -> 'exhausted'; 403 'not subscribed' -> 'not_subscribed'; 401 -> 'unauthorized'; a 2xx -> 'ok'), computes resetAt = at + resetSeconds and lastCallCost = previous remaining minus new remaining when both are known and the previous observation is under 60 s old, and persists the whole map to AppConfig key jobs.providerQuota.v1 (upsert, as platform/billing/fxReference.ts does for fx.reference): at once on a state change, otherwise at most once every 60 s per provider. hydrateProviderQuota(db) loads the stored map into memory (a stored snapshot whose resetAt has passed is treated as 'unknown' with remaining null until a new response arrives); it is called at the start of runJobsPlan and runJobsIngest (server/src/features/jobs/ingest/cron.ts 54-73), of the ingest.query worker path and of ingestForProfile (server/src/features/jobs/ingest/index.ts 54-58). registerQuotaListeners() wires the two clients; server/src/features/jobs/ingest/index.ts and server/src/features/jobs/ingest/cron.ts import quota.ts for that side effect, and server/src/cron/handlers.ts already imports ingest/cron.js at process start, so interactive callers of the clients (onboarding chat, the Assistant, the job-search API) are covered on every deployment without importing ingest themselves. (3) Read API for the rest of ingest: quotaSnapshot(provider), quotaAllows(provider, purpose: 'ingest' | 'interactive', now, env): ingest is refused while state is exhausted / not_subscribed / unauthorized and resetAt is in the future, or while requestsRemaining <= reserve where reserve = max(1, ceil(requestsLimit x INGEST_QUOTA_RESERVE_SHARE)) (default share 0.05); interactive use (onboarding, Assistant, the job-search API) is refused only at remaining 0 or a closed state. With no snapshot both are allowed.
ACCEPT: The 'Accepted when' of JI-1, server half: a mocked 429 whose headers say remaining 0 and reset in 16.9 days writes state 'exhausted', plan 'BASIC' and resetAt to AppConfig, quotaAllows(provider,'ingest') is false until that instant and true after it; a 200 with remaining 9,773 of 10,000 gives state ok and lastCallCost equal to the delta from the previous response; a 403 not-subscribed response gives not_subscribed; nothing is written more than once a minute for an unchanged state; a second process that only calls hydrateProviderQuota sees the same answer without any provider call; the RapidAPI key never appears in a snapshot or a log line.
TESTS: server/src/features/jobs/ingest/quota.test.ts with a fake AppConfig delegate and a fixed clock: state derivation, reserve arithmetic, debounce, hydrate, expiry of a stale snapshot. server/src/roboapply/v2/lib/raRapidApiJobs.test.ts and raFantasticJobs.test.ts with a mocked fetch: the listener receives the header values for 200 / 429 / 403, not for a cache hit, and a throwing listener does not fail the search.
FILES: server/src/features/jobs/ingest/quota.ts, server/src/features/jobs/ingest/quota.test.ts, server/src/features/jobs/ingest/cron.ts, server/src/features/jobs/ingest/index.ts, server/src/features/jobs/ingest/workers.ts, server/src/roboapply/v2/lib/raRapidApiJobs.ts, server/src/roboapply/v2/lib/raRapidApiJobs.test.ts, server/src/roboapply/v2/lib/raFantasticJobs.ts, server/src/roboapply/v2/lib/raFantasticJobs.test.ts

[P0] One budget per provider: the quota gates planning, leasing and every client call; mainland calls are counted under :cn (JI-1, JC-6 preparation; strategy 1.2; critic C13) CHANGE: Today two independent counters exist: ingest's RAProviderUsage budget (server/src/features/jobs/ingest/pipeline.ts reserveProviderCall 209-217, used in runIngestQuery 312-322 with DEFAULT_DAILY_CALLS 300 / 150 / 200 in config.ts 23-27) and an in-process daily budget inside each client (raRapidApiJobs.ts dailyBudget 344-348, default 300; raFantasticJobs.ts 41 and 323-324). Replace them with one. (1) server/src/features/jobs/ingest/config.ts: effectiveDailyLimit(provider, market, env, now) = the smaller of INGEST__DAILY_CALLS (when set; RA_ONBOARDING_

_DAILY_BUDGET is read as a deprecated alias when the INGEST name is unset, logged once) and, when a snapshot with requestsRemaining and resetAt exists, floor((requestsRemaining - reserve) / max(1, daysToReset)); without env and without a snapshot the old defaults apply. For market 'cn' the limit is INGEST__CN_DAILY_CALLS (default 0: nothing is called for GoApply until MKT-5A opens Active Jobs DB behind its quota gate). dailyCallLimit(provider) stays exported for the admin Limits page. (2) pipeline.ts runIngestQuery: before reserving, when the adapter is metered and quotaAllows(provider,'ingest') is false, push every due query of that provider to the quota's resetAt (or one hour ahead when resetAt is unknown) with buildDeferProviderSql (255-261) and return status 'quota' (a new QueryRunResult status; run.ts addToTally lists the provider in budgetStops and drops it for the tick like 'budget'). Reservation and usage rows use usageKey(provider, ctx.market) and effectiveDailyLimit; adapter enablement uses adapterEnabledFor(adapter, ctx.market) at line 308. (3) Clients: delete the in-process daily counters and their warn-once state; each client exports setCallGate(gate | null) where gate(provider, purpose) returns false to refuse a call; quota.ts registers a gate that answers quotaAllows(...) and, for calls not made by ingest, records one call in RAProviderUsage through recordProviderUsage. JobSearchProvider.search opts (server/src/roboapply/v2/lib/raExternalJobTypes.ts 142-149) gain reservedByIngest?: boolean; the ingest adapter (server/src/features/jobs/ingest/adapters/rapidApi.ts fetch, 106-116) passes true so an ingest call is counted once. isJSearchEnabled / isFantasticJobsEnabled consult the gate for 'interactive'. The LRU caches, circuit breakers and kill switches stay. (4) Fairness for cursor sources (strategy 1.3 time budget, C12): server/src/features/jobs/ingest/run.ts runIngestTick (71-110) tracks milliseconds spent per cursor provider in the tick; a cursor provider that keeps answering 'more' is dropped from the tick's enabled map once it has used more than INGEST_CURSOR_TICK_SHARE (default 0.4) of budgetMs, so a multi-run sweep (台灣就業通, the licensed feed) cannot starve users' demand queries; its query stays due and continues on the next tick. (5) Refresh interval by country (strategy 1.2 tier 2 and 1.3). Contract (identical in MKT-3B, which owns planner.ts in this phase): RefreshInput = { origin, demandScore, consecutiveEmpty, country?: string | null }. runIngestQuery computes the next run (today line 360) from a variable, const refreshInput = { origin: query.origin, demandScore: row.demandScore, consecutiveEmpty, country: query.params.country ?? null }, and calls nextRunDelayMs(refreshInput). MKT-3B adds the optional country to RefreshInput (Taiwan demand every 12 h, other cold demand every 24 h, hot 6 h); a variable instead of an object literal compiles with or without that field, so either merge order works. ACCEPT: With a snapshot of 25 requests a month and 0 left, a jobs-ingest tick makes no Active Jobs DB call, defers its due queries to the reset time and reports the provider under budgetStops; with 9,773 of 10,000 JSearch requests left and 17 days to reset the effective daily limit is 545 (floor((9773 - 500) / 17)) unless INGEST_JSEARCH_DAILY_CALLS is lower; an onboarding search and an ingest query in the same day add up in one RAProviderUsage row; a query run for GoApply is counted under 'activejobs:cn' and is refused while INGEST_ACTIVEJOBS_CN_DAILY_CALLS is unset; no file still holds a second, client-local daily counter; a cursor adapter that always answers 'more' stops after about 40% of a tick and the remaining queries of the tick still run; the next-run computation hands the query's country to nextRunDelayMs (asserted with a spy or through the resulting nextRunAt once MKT-3B is merged). TESTS: server/src/features/jobs/ingest/pipeline.test.ts (quota stop defers by provider, the :cn key, single counting with reservedByIngest), server/src/features/jobs/ingest/cron.test.ts (a tick with an exhausted provider), a new case in pipeline.test.ts or run tests for the cursor share with a fake clock, the two client test files (gate refuses, gate allows, cache hit bypasses the gate), server/src/features/jobs/ingest/adapters/adapters.test.ts (the adapter passes reservedByIngest). Update the SQL snapshots under ingest/__snapshots__ only where the usage key parameter changed. FILES: server/src/features/jobs/ingest/config.ts, server/src/features/jobs/ingest/pipeline.ts, server/src/features/jobs/ingest/pipeline.test.ts, server/src/features/jobs/ingest/run.ts, server/src/features/jobs/ingest/cron.test.ts, server/src/features/jobs/ingest/quota.ts, server/src/features/jobs/ingest/adapters/rapidApi.ts, server/src/features/jobs/ingest/adapters/adapters.test.ts, server/src/roboapply/v2/lib/raRapidApiJobs.ts, server/src/roboapply/v2/lib/raFantasticJobs.ts, server/src/roboapply/v2/lib/raExternalJobTypes.ts, their tests and server/src/features/jobs/ingest/__snapshots__/*.snap

[P0] JSearch client: employer-direct is decided by the link host (JI-6; strategy M-3; INTL note 3.1, 8.1 M7)
CHANGE: The 2026-10-11 probes found one apply option per job and is_direct true on 0 of 58 rows, so server/src/roboapply/v2/lib/raRapidApiJobs.ts pickApplyUrl (164-170) cannot work as written. Rewrite it as a host rule using atsTypeFromUrl and isJobBoardHost from server/src/features/jobs/normalize/index.ts (roboapply/v2/lib already imports that module in raCrossBankMatch.ts): collect job_apply_link and every apply_options[].apply_link that is a valid http(s) URL; choose, in order, the first link on an ATS host or an unknown employer host (atsTypeFromUrl not null), then the first link on a job board that is not LinkedIn, then a LinkedIn link; isDirect is true exactly when the chosen link is on an ATS or employer host (an explicit is_direct / job_apply_is_direct true is still honoured). pickSourceUrl (173-188) keeps the publisher page for provenance. normalizeJSearchJob (194-248) passes the result through unchanged otherwise. Nothing may depend on job_highlights (empty on every probed row): confirm by search that no reader requires it and delete any dead read. Keep num_pages 2 (line 450); the cost of the second page is now visible as lastCallCost in the quota snapshot, so do not change paging in this bundle. The rule that a row whose only link is LinkedIn or Indeed is not ingested lives in the normalizer (MKT-3C); this client still returns such rows to interactive callers, who already hide LinkedIn links.
ACCEPT: The 'employer-host link is marked direct' half of JI-6: a fixture row whose single link is boards.greenhouse.io/acme/jobs/1 has applyIsDirect true; a row with a LinkedIn link and a careers.acme.com option applies on careers.acme.com with applyIsDirect true and keeps the LinkedIn page only as sourceUrl provenance (which the normalizer then drops from every source field); a row with only a ZipRecruiter link is not direct; a row with empty apply_options and is_direct false everywhere behaves as before for the URL and gets the host-derived flag.
TESTS: server/src/roboapply/v2/lib/raRapidApiJobs.test.ts: the four link shapes above from fixtures modelled on the probe counts (no live call), plus a row with an invalid URL in apply_options.
FILES: server/src/roboapply/v2/lib/raRapidApiJobs.ts, server/src/roboapply/v2/lib/raRapidApiJobs.test.ts

[P1] JSearch query building for Taiwan: Traditional Chinese text with language=zh-TW (JT-3; strategy 1.3, 2.5; TW note 5.1)
CHANGE: server/src/features/jobs/ingest/adapters/rapidApi.ts rapidApiSearchParams (46-61) builds '<q> in <city>' for every JSearch query and never sets language, so Taiwan demand is searched in English and returns a LinkedIn-heavy mix. Change, for provider 'jsearch' only: when the resolved country (rapidApiCountry, 32-40) is TW and params.q contains a CJK character, the query is '<q> <city in Traditional Chinese>' (the city table's zhHant name from findCity / citiesNamed; the English name when the table has none) with no ' in ' joiner, and language = 'zh-TW'; otherwise the English form stays and no language is sent. datePosted is passed through as planned (the planner sends 'month' for Taiwan, MKT-3B); 'remote' keeps work_from_home. Active Jobs DB keeps the English title and location name (it searches English ATS postings). The planner side (two tuples per Taiwan role) is MKT-3B; this function must give the right request for either text.
ACCEPT: rapidApiSearchParams({ q: '軟體工程師', country: 'TW', city: 'Taipei', datePosted: 'month' }, 'jsearch') returns query '軟體工程師 台北', country 'tw', language 'zh-TW', datePosted 'month'; the English tuple for the same role returns 'software engineer in Taipei' with no language; a Chinese query for a non-Taiwan country is not given language zh-TW; the existing WP-42 assertion (a Taiwanese city forces country=tw) still passes.
TESTS: server/src/features/jobs/ingest/adapters/adapters.test.ts: the three cases above and a city missing from the table.
FILES: server/src/features/jobs/ingest/adapters/rapidApi.ts, server/src/features/jobs/ingest/adapters/adapters.test.ts

[P1] Known employer domains reach the normalizer, page by page (JI-5 support; strategy 1.5 K3)
CHANGE: server/src/features/jobs/ingest/pipeline.ts processJobs (71-172): before the normalize loop build companyDomains: ReadonlyMap<string, string> for the page and pass it in the NormalizeContext (the optional field MKT-1C declared; MKT-3C reads it when it builds the dedupe key). Sources of the map, in this order: (1) domains the page's own inputs state (input.companyFacts.domain, or the host of companyFacts.website) keyed by the normalised company name (use normalizeCompanyName from server/src/features/jobs/normalize/index.ts, the same function the normalizer uses); (2) one query for the remaining names of the page: SELECT "nameNormalized", "domain" FROM "RACompany" WHERE "market" = ctx.market AND "nameNormalized" = ANY(names) AND "domain" IS NOT NULL. The map carries the hosts as stored or stated (RACompany.domain is the stated domain or the website's host, unfiltered); MKT-3C's key logic reduces each value to a registrable domain and rejects job-board and ATS hosts, so this function does no host filtering beyond dropping empty values. One extra read per page; no write. Nothing else in processJobs changes: the apply-URL rule (125-128), the wrong_market rule (129-133) and the applyDedupe call (166) stay as they are.
ACCEPT: For a page with two inputs of the same normalised company, one of which states the website, both normalize calls receive that domain; a company whose RACompany row already has a domain is looked up once per page, not once per row; a page of 100 rows makes exactly one extra query; with no domain known anywhere the context carries an empty map and the output is identical to before.
TESTS: server/src/features/jobs/ingest/pipeline.test.ts with the fake db: the map content for the three sources and the single query.
FILES: server/src/features/jobs/ingest/pipeline.ts, server/src/features/jobs/ingest/pipeline.test.ts

bundles.title: Planner: adapter cost model, no SEO seeds on per-request providers, demand windows, Taiwan query variants
items:
[P0] SEO seed tuples are planned only on sources that cost nothing per request (JI-2; strategy M-3, 1.2; INTL note 6.3, 8.1 M2)
CHANGE: server/src/features/jobs/ingest/planner.ts planQueries (197-217) plans one query per search adapter for every tuple, so the default 900 seed tuples (300 roles x 3 cities, seedTuples 136-150) are multiplied onto JSearch, a provider billed per request with a monthly quota. Change: for a tuple with origin 'seo_seed', skip every adapter whose adapterCostModel (MKT-1C, server/src/features/jobs/sources/types.ts) is 'per_request'; demand tuples are unaffected. runPlanner (337-352) then retires what earlier plans created: one statement sets enabled = false for RAIngestQuery rows with origin 'seo_seed' whose provider is a per_request adapter of this market (retireSeedsFor(db, market, providers), reported as seedsRetired in PlannerResult). Seeds for free and per-job sources stay as they are; while no such search adapter is enabled the seed tuples simply plan nothing (board sync and the bank need no query). Declare costModel explicitly where this bundle owns the adapter list: the source registry added by the parity wave (server/src/features/jobs/sources/registry.ts) exposes costModel per source so the admin console can show it. Update the planner header comment (lines 3-16) and the test names that say 'one query per provider'.
ACCEPT: The 'Accepted when' of JI-2: with default env, the RoboApply adapter list of the parity wave (activejobs, bank_robohire, jsearch, ats_public; linkedin already removed by PAR-1) and a brand with no users, runPlanner plans zero JSearch queries and zero LinkedIn queries; a demand tuple still plans a JSearch query; a database that holds old JSearch seed queries has them disabled after one plan run and a second run changes nothing; seeds remain planned for a per_job search adapter that is enabled.
TESTS: server/src/features/jobs/ingest/planner.test.ts: planQueries with a per_request, a per_job and a free fake adapter for seed and demand tuples; retireSeedsFor SQL through the fake db; the PlannerResult counters. server/src/features/jobs/sources/registry.test.ts: costModel is reported for every registered source.
FILES: server/src/features/jobs/ingest/planner.ts, server/src/features/jobs/ingest/planner.test.ts, server/src/features/jobs/sources/registry.ts, server/src/features/jobs/sources/registry.test.ts

[P0] A provider that is unsubscribed, out of quota or off for the market is not planned (JI-2; strategy 1.1; INTL note 1 item 2)
CHANGE: The planner created LinkedIn queries for an API that answers 403 and Active Jobs DB queries for a plan with 25 requests a month. In planQueries and in ensureBankSyncQueries (308-324) use adapterEnabledFor(adapter, tuple.market) from MKT-1C instead of the bare markets check: an adapter that reports disabled (no key, kill switch, breaker open after a 403 / 401, or the quota gate of MKT-3A closed) gets no new or refreshed query in this run, and its existing queries are left alone (they are deferred at lease time by MKT-3A, not disabled, so they resume when the quota resets). server/src/features/jobs/ingest/providers.ts adaptersForBrand (44-51): keep the parity wave's registry order; add listEnabledAdaptersFor(brand, env) used by cron and by the targeted ingest so both apply the same rule. Remove the special case at planner.ts line 205 ('GoApply testing provider: country=cn only') only if the parity wave left it behind; GoApply has no per-request search provider. server/src/roboapply/v2/lib/raJobProviders.ts: the registry comment (76-86) and externalProviders order are updated to the two remaining RapidAPI providers when PAR-1 removed linkedin from the brand list; if the linkedin client object is still exported, enabledExternalProviders must not return it for RoboApply (it is unsubscribed and dropped by decision M-4).
ACCEPT: With the Active Jobs DB adapter reporting disabled, a plan run writes no activejobs query and reports the provider in a new PlannerResult.skippedProviders list; when the adapter is enabled again the next run plans it; the parity acceptance 'adaptersForBrand(goapply) never includes jsearch' still holds; searchAllProviders never calls a LinkedIn client for a RoboApply request.
TESTS: server/src/features/jobs/ingest/planner.test.ts (disabled adapter, market-specific isEnabledFor), server/src/roboapply/v2/lib/raJobProviders.test.ts (provider list and fan-out without linkedin).
FILES: server/src/features/jobs/ingest/planner.ts, server/src/features/jobs/ingest/planner.test.ts, server/src/features/jobs/ingest/providers.ts, server/src/roboapply/v2/lib/raJobProviders.ts, server/src/roboapply/v2/lib/raJobProviders.test.ts

[P1] Demand queries ask for a window that matches their refresh interval (JI-6; strategy 1.2 tier 2; INTL note 6.3, 6.5)
CHANGE: server/src/features/jobs/ingest/planner.ts paramsForTuple (188-194) sends datePosted 'week' for every tuple while hot tuples refresh every 6 hours (REFRESH 33-42). Make the window and the refresh interval follow strategy 1.2 tier 2 (6 h hot / 24 h cold) and 1.3 (Taiwan every 12 h): demandScore >= 5 (hot, refreshed every 6 h) -> '3days'; other demand tuples -> 'week', and their interval becomes 24 h (REFRESH.demandMs is 12 h today: add REFRESH.coldDemandMs = 24 h and use it in baseRefreshMs for a demandScore of 1 to 4); a Taiwan tuple refreshes every 12 h whatever its score (REFRESH.twDemandMs = 12 h) with the window of the next item. baseRefreshMs and nextRunDelayMs read the country from a new OPTIONAL field of RefreshInput, country?: string | null ('TW' selects the Taiwan interval; absent or anything else keeps the hot / cold rule). Contract (identical in MKT-3A, which owns pipeline.ts in this phase): RefreshInput = { origin, demandScore, consecutiveEmpty, country?: string | null }; pipeline.ts builds const refreshInput = { origin: query.origin, demandScore: row.demandScore, consecutiveEmpty, country: query.params.country ?? null } and calls nextRunDelayMs(refreshInput), a variable and not an object literal, so it compiles with or without the new field and either merge order works; remote tuples keep remote: true so the JSearch adapter sends work_from_home; Taiwan tuples -> 'month' (next item). Because datePosted is part of paramsHash (178-186), a tuple that moves between hot and cold would otherwise leave a stale twin: plan with the hash of the tuple identity (market, taxonomy id or text, country, city, remote, query language) and treat datePosted as a mutable param that upsertPlannedQueries (265-289) updates in place (extend the ON CONFLICT clause to set "params" = EXCLUDED."params" while keeping any stored cursor). One migration-free consequence: queries created before this change keep their old hash and retire through retireUnusedDemand (296-305) as nobody plans them again. Never plan a JSearch query whose window is shorter than its refresh interval.
ACCEPT: A tuple with 6 users plans datePosted '3days' and is due again after 6 hours; with 2 users 'week' and 24 hours; a Taiwan tuple is due again after 12 hours at either score; seed (24 h) and bank (30 min) intervals are unchanged; raising a tuple from 2 to 6 users updates the same RAIngestQuery row to '3days' instead of creating a second row; a remote tuple carries remote true; the window always covers at least one full refresh interval.
TESTS: server/src/features/jobs/ingest/planner.test.ts: the baseRefreshMs table (hot 6 h, cold 24 h, Taiwan 12 h, seed 24 h, bank 30 min; no country behaves as before for hot and seed), window by demand score, hash stability across a hot / cold change, the upsert statement keeps the cursor of a cursor query.
FILES: server/src/features/jobs/ingest/planner.ts, server/src/features/jobs/ingest/planner.test.ts

[P1] Taiwan demand is planned twice: once in Traditional Chinese, once in English, both over a month (JT-3, SM-11; strategy 1.3, 2.5; TW note 5.1)
CHANGE: In tuplesFromFilters / primaryRole (95-133) and paramsForTuple: for a tuple whose country is TW (or whose city is a Taiwanese city) plan two queries on per-request search adapters that take free text (jsearch): variant A with q = the taxonomy node's zhHant label (MKT-1C added the optional field; MKT-3E fills it) and variant B with q = the English label; both with datePosted 'month' (a one-week non-tech query returned 0 rows in the probe). When the role is the user's own typed title, plan it as typed, in whichever script it is in, plus nothing else. When a node has no zhHant label yet, plan only the English variant (never a Simplified label for Taiwan). The city stays the city-table English name in params; MKT-3A's rapidApiSearchParams turns it into the Traditional Chinese name for the Chinese variant. The tuple key and paramsHash include the query text so the two variants are two rows. Mainland tuples (market cn) use the zh label; nothing is planned for them until a search adapter is enabled for cn (MKT-5A). Take the query texts from providerQueryLabels(roleId, { market, country }) of server/src/features/jobs/taxonomy/queryLabels.ts (delivered by MKT-1E in M1; items are { text, language: 'en' | 'zh-TW' | 'zh-CN' }): the first 'en' item is variant B, the 'zh-TW' item (returned only once a Traditional label exists) is variant A, and for market cn the first 'zh-CN' item; the planner does not read node labels itself, so one function owns the per-market query labels. This item is the planner half of SM-11's 'zh / zhHant query labels'.
ACCEPT: The 'Accepted when' of JT-3: a Taiwan demand tuple for a role with a zhHant label plans exactly one zh-Hant JSearch query and one English JSearch query, both datePosted 'month'; without a zhHant label only the English one; a United States tuple plans one English query with the window of the previous item; an Active Jobs DB adapter gets the English variant only.
TESTS: server/src/features/jobs/ingest/planner.test.ts with a taxonomy node fixture that carries zhHant and one that does not.
FILES: server/src/features/jobs/ingest/planner.ts, server/src/features/jobs/ingest/planner.test.ts

bundles.title: Posting identity and lifecycle: atsPostingKey, canonical-row priority, JSearch link rules, expiry rules, carry-through fields
items:
[P0] atsPostingKey: the exact key {ats}:{tenant}:{postingId} parsed from apply and source URLs (JI-5; strategy 1.5 K2; INTL note 7.1)
CHANGE: server/src/features/jobs/normalize/ats.ts: add atsPostingKeyFromUrl(url) and atsPostingKeyFromUrls(applyUrl, sourceUrl) returning '<ats>:<tenant>:<postingId>' in lower case (the posting id keeps its case when the ATS id is case-sensitive: Workable shortcodes and Ashby / Lever UUIDs are lower-cased, numeric ids are digits) or null. Patterns, each verified by a unit test on real URL shapes from the notes: Greenhouse boards.greenhouse.io/{token}/jobs/{id} and job-boards.greenhouse.io/{token}/jobs/{id} (an employer page that only carries ?gh_jid={id} gives null: the tenant is not in the URL and is never guessed); Lever jobs.lever.co/{site}/{uuid} -> lever:{site}:{uuid}, jobs.eu.lever.co/{site}/{uuid} -> lever_eu:{site}:{uuid}; Ashby jobs.ashbyhq.com/{org}/{uuid}; SmartRecruiters jobs.smartrecruiters.com/{company}/{id} (the id is the leading digits of the last path segment); Workable apply.workable.com/{slug}/j/{shortcode}; Workday {tenant}.wd{n}.myworkdayjobs.com/…/job/…/{slug}_{requisitionId} -> workday:{tenant}:{requisitionId}; iCIMS {sub}.icims.com/jobs/{id}/… -> icims:{sub}:{id}. Also extend ATS_HOSTS (10-24) and the AtsType union in server/src/features/jobs/normalize/types.ts with recruitee ((^|.)recruitee.com), personio ((^|.)jobs.personio.(de|com)), teamtailor ((^|.)teamtailor.com) and bamboohr ((^|.)bamboohr.com), so links to those boards are classified now (their connectors are MKT-5B) and the RAJob.atsType doc comment lists them. server/src/features/jobs/normalize/normalizeProviderJob.ts computes atsPostingKey next to atsType (line 200) for every provider; for ats_public rows it must equal '<sourceBoard>:<boardToken>:<postingId>' built from the row's own externalId (a test pins that the URL parse and the externalId agree for the four connectors). NormalizedJob gains atsPostingKey: string | null. server/src/features/jobs/ingest/upsert.ts: add the column to JobUpsertRow, UPSERT_COLUMNS (147-159), toUpsertRow (180-249), valuesTuple and the ON CONFLICT list (300-363) as "atsPostingKey" = EXCLUDED."atsPostingKey".
ACCEPT: A JSearch row whose link is boards.greenhouse.io/stripe/jobs/123 and the Greenhouse board row 'stripe:123' carry the same atsPostingKey 'greenhouse:stripe:123'; a careers page with only ?gh_jid= gives null; every pattern above has a positive and a negative test; an existing row is updated with its key on the next ingest; the upsert SQL snapshot shows the one new column and no other change.
TESTS: server/src/features/jobs/normalize/rules.test.ts or a new server/src/features/jobs/normalize/ats.test.ts (pattern table, hosts), server/src/features/jobs/normalize/normalizeProviderJob.test.ts (key on all providers; agreement with ats_public externalId), server/src/features/jobs/ingest/upsert.test.ts and its snapshot.
FILES: server/src/features/jobs/normalize/ats.ts, server/src/features/jobs/normalize/types.ts, server/src/features/jobs/normalize/normalizeProviderJob.ts, server/src/features/jobs/normalize/index.ts, their tests, server/src/features/jobs/ingest/upsert.ts, server/src/features/jobs/ingest/upsert.test.ts, server/src/features/jobs/ingest/__snapshots__/upsert.test.ts.snap

[P0] Canonical row: K2 before K3, employer board at priority 5, GoHire bank at priority 3, never across markets (JI-5, JC-7; strategy 1.5; critic C10)
CHANGE: (1) server/src/features/jobs/normalize/source.ts PROVIDER_META: ats_public sourcePriority 10 -> 5 (it tied with activejobs); bank_gohire 15 -> 3 (mainland order is GoHire bank > employer board > aggregator); bank_robohire stays 15. Update the comments in server/src/features/jobs/normalize/types.ts (NormalizedJob.sourcePriority) and the upsert header. (2) server/src/features/jobs/ingest/upsert.ts buildDedupeSql (421-442) / applyDedupe (444-447), without changing applyDedupe's signature (server/src/features/jobs/ingest/pipeline.ts line 166 keeps calling it with the page's dedupe keys): add a first statement that aligns exact twins: for live public rows of the market whose atsPostingKey equals that of any row carrying one of the given dedupe keys, set dedupeKey to the dedupeKey of the best row of that atsPostingKey group (lowest sourcePriority, then firstSeenAt, then id) where it differs; then run the existing ranking over the given keys plus the keys adopted in step one. The maintenance call (keys null) aligns every atsPostingKey group touched in the last two days. Both statements filter "market" = the given market, so rows in different markets never collapse (keep the existing WHERE; add a test that proves it). (3) Ranking order inside a group becomes: for Taiwan rows (locationCountry 'TW') a row with salaryDisclosed true first (twins from 台灣就業通 and from 104 through JSearch: prefer the row with disclosed pay); then sourcePriority ascending; then a row whose apply URL is on an employer or ATS host ("atsType" IS NOT NULL) before a job-board link; then postedAt descending nulls last, firstSeenAt, id (today's tail). Mirror the order in compareForCanonical (396-409) and DedupeCandidate. (4) server/src/features/jobs/ingest/maintain.ts: add alignSourcePriority(db, market), one idempotent UPDATE per changed provider that sets sourcePriority to the PROVIDER_META value for live rows that still carry the old number (sourceBoard in the four public ATS names and sourcePriority 10 -> 5; sourceBoard 'gohire' and 15 -> 3), run in runMaintenance (185-207) before the dedupe repair; report the count.
ACCEPT: The 'Accepted when' of JI-5: a JSearch row and a board row for the same Greenhouse posting collapse to one canonical board row even when their titles differ in wording; a GoHire bank row beats the same employer's board row for the same company, title and city; the same posting key in market intl and market cn stays two independent canonical rows; a Taiwan open-data row with pay beats a JSearch twin without pay; after one maintenance run no live ats row has priority 10 and no gohire row has 15; alternates stay live (no closeReason), as today.
TESTS: server/src/features/jobs/ingest/upsert.test.ts: compareForCanonical table (priority, Taiwan pay rule, employer-host tie-break), the two SQL statements in the snapshot, market isolation through the fake db. server/src/features/jobs/ingest/maintain.test.ts: alignSourcePriority statements and that a second run updates nothing. server/src/features/jobs/normalize/normalizeProviderJob.test.ts: the new priorities.
FILES: server/src/features/jobs/normalize/source.ts, server/src/features/jobs/normalize/types.ts, server/src/features/jobs/ingest/upsert.ts, server/src/features/jobs/ingest/upsert.test.ts, server/src/features/jobs/ingest/__snapshots__/upsert.test.ts.snap, server/src/features/jobs/ingest/maintain.ts, server/src/features/jobs/ingest/maintain.test.ts

[P1] The employer's domain replaces the company name in the fuzzy key when a source gives one (JI-5; strategy 1.5 K3; INTL note 7.1)
CHANGE: server/src/features/jobs/normalize/identity.ts dedupeKey (32-34) hashes companyNameNormalized | titleNormalized | place, so name variants agree only when the name normaliser happens to fold them and two different companies called 'Summit' collide. Rule: the company part of the key is the employer's registrable domain when one is known for the row, else the normalised name as today. A domain is known when (a) the source states it (raw.companyFacts.domain, or the host of raw.companyFacts.website) and that host is the employer's own (isJobBoardHost false and atsTypeFromUrl 'other': never an ATS or job-board host), or (b) NormalizeContext.companyDomains (the optional map nameNormalized -> domain that MKT-1C declared and MKT-3A fills from RACompany rows of the market and from the other rows of the same page) has an entry for the row's companyNameNormalized (the map carries raw hosts: pass every candidate through registrableDomain and the same employer-host test before use). With a domain the key is sha1('d:' + domain + '|' + titleNormalized + '|' + place); without one it is byte-identical to today's. Route (b) is what keeps a row that states no website on the same key as its twin that does. Add registrableDomain(urlOrHost) to server/src/features/jobs/normalize/company.ts: lower case, strip 'www.' and the career sub-domains careers., jobs., job., work., boards., apply., recruiting.; keep the last two labels, or the last three for these two-part suffixes: co.uk, com.au, com.sg, com.tw, co.jp, com.cn, com.hk, co.nz, com.br, co.in, co.kr; an IP address, a single-label host or a host on a shared-hosting suffix the helper does not know (github.io, notion.site, wixsite.com, webflow.io) gives null, and null always falls back to the name key. Stored rows keep their old key until they are re-ingested; the dedupe repair in jobs-maintain then regroups them (no backfill statement: the hash cannot be recomputed in SQL).
ACCEPT: registrableDomain('https://careers.stripe.com/jobs/1') is 'stripe.com', of 'jobs.foo.co.uk' is 'foo.co.uk' and of 'acme.github.io' is null; inputs named 'Stripe' and 'Stripe, Inc.' that both resolve to stripe.com (one by its stated website, one through ctx.companyDomains) get the same dedupeKey; two inputs named 'Summit' with different stated domains get different keys; with no stated domain and no map entry every key is byte-identical to today's (the existing identity tests are unchanged).
TESTS: server/src/features/jobs/normalize/rules.test.ts (registrable domain table), server/src/features/jobs/normalize/normalizeProviderJob.test.ts (stated domain, map entry, neither).
FILES: server/src/features/jobs/normalize/identity.ts, server/src/features/jobs/normalize/company.ts, server/src/features/jobs/normalize/normalizeProviderJob.ts, their tests

[P0] JSearch rows: a posting whose only link is LinkedIn or Indeed is not ingested; a board-only link lives 21 days (JI-6; strategy M-3, 1.5; INTL note 8.1 M7, 8.2 S6)
CHANGE: server/src/features/jobs/normalize/normalizeProviderJob.ts (source step, 189-201): for aggregator providers (jsearch; the rule is written per provider in one table so it can be extended) classify the usable links (applyUrl and sourceUrl after safeUrl): when every link is on a LinkedIn host (isLinkedInHost) or on an Indeed host (the indeed brand pattern in server/src/features/jobs/normalize/ats.ts BOARD_BRANDS), set applyUrl to null and add the note 'linkedin_only_link' or 'indeed_only_link'; the ingest pipeline already drops a row without an apply URL and counts its notes (pipeline.ts 124-128), so the skip is counted with no pipeline change. A row that has an employer or ATS link next to a LinkedIn link keeps the employer link (MKT-3A already prefers it). bundles.title: Employer boards: sources for both markets, discovery, bulk import, seeds, sync throughput and its own cron
items:
[P0] A career-site source carries origin, discoveredFrom, countries and sync state, and is no longer tied to one market (JI-3, JC-4, JT-5; strategy 1.2 company list, 1.4 tier 1; critic C9)
CHANGE: The M0 schema bundle adds to RACareerSiteSource: origin ('admin' | 'seed' | 'import' | 'discovered'), discoveredFrom, countries (ISO alpha-2 codes the board is read for; empty = every country the brands serve), failCount, lastChangeAt, nextSyncAt, disabledAt. (ats, boardToken) stays unique, so a board shared by Taiwan and the mainland (BoschGroup) is ONE row. server/src/features/jobs/sources/atsPublic/contract.ts: CareerSourceBodySchema (15-25) gains countries: array of /^[A-Z]{2}$/ (max 60, default []); PatchCareerSourceBodySchema gains countries; CareerSourceView gains origin, discoveredFrom, countries, failCount, lastChangeAt, nextSyncAt, disabledAt. Export sourceCoversCountry(source, iso) (true for an empty list). The legacy countryCode stays what it is: a weak hint for an ambiguous city, never a filter. [P0] Board sync engine: its own cron, 4-8 boards in flight, adaptive interval, no size cap for single-call boards, User-Agent, disable after three failures (JI-4; strategy 1.2 tier 0, 1.5 closure; INTL note 6.1, 8.1 M4, 8.2 S7)
CHANGE: Today one standing ingest query reads 3 boards serially per fetch, every 6 h, at most 500 postings each (server/src/features/jobs/sources/atsPublic/shared.ts 8-12, server/src/features/jobs/sources/atsPublic/adapter.ts 60-79, server/src/features/jobs/sources/atsPublic/sync.ts dueCareerSources 113-126) inside the 240 s budget shared with every other query. Replace with a dedicated run. (1) New server/src/features/jobs/ingest/boards.ts (in the ingest area, so it may call processJobs and archiveClosedBankJobs; the atsPublic folder still never calls ingest internals): runBoardSync({ db, budget, now, env, fetch }) loops until the budget has under 20 s left or nothing is due: lease up to 2 x concurrency due sources with one raw statement (UPDATE "RACareerSiteSource" SET "nextSyncAt" = now() + interval '15 minutes' WHERE "id" IN (SELECT "id" … WHERE "enabled" AND ("nextSyncAt" IS NULL OR "nextSyncAt" <= now()) ORDER BY "nextSyncAt" ASC NULLS FIRST LIMIT n FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED) RETURNING *), read them with ATS_BOARDS_CONCURRENCY requests in flight (default 6, clamped to 4-8), then write one board at a time: split the postings by market (item 4), call processJobs once per market that has postings (PipelineContext brand = the brand serving that market, only when that brand is in allowedBrands() and ingestAllowed(brand); wrap in runWithBrand), archive closures with reason 'source_removed', and stamp the source. (2) Stamp rules: success -> lastSyncedAt, lastJobCount, lastError null, failCount 0, lastChangeAt = now when the run inserted or closed a posting, nextSyncAt = now + 2 h when lastChangeAt is within 48 h, + 12 h when within 14 days, + 24 h otherwise; a source never read is due immediately. A hard failure (board_not_found, redirect, unexpected_shape, not_json) increments failCount and retries in 1 h; the third consecutive hard failure sets enabled false and disabledAt now. A transient failure (timeout, http_5xx, network) retries in 1 h x min(attempts, 6) and never disables. At the start of each run, sources with enabled false and disabledAt older than 48 h have their open public rows archived as 'source_removed' (idempotent updateMany; the upsert revives them if an admin turns the source back on). (3) Size: delete BOARDS_PER_FETCH and SYNC_INTERVAL_MS; MAX_POSTINGS_PER_BOARD no longer limits Greenhouse or Ashby (one call lists everything: every listed posting is handed to the normalizer, connectors.ts 178 and 302) nor Lever (page with skip / limit 100 to the end, safety stop at 100 pages which marks the listing incomplete, 234-246); prioritise (81-93) remains for SmartRecruiters details only (item 3). (4) server/src/features/jobs/sources/atsPublic/http.ts getJson (55-87) sends 'User-Agent': sourceUserAgent('intl', env) from MKT-1C next to Accept. (5) server/src/features/jobs/sources/atsPublic/adapter.ts: the ats_public adapter stays registered (the registry, maintenance and the admin console read its provider, markets and sourceBoards) with costModel 'free', but fetch answers { jobs: [], calls: 0, exhausted: true } because the cron is now the only reader; service.ts runNow (160-201) keeps its listing-only read under 15 s, then sets nextSyncAt null and answers queued: true (due at the next board sync) without touching RAIngestQuery or the work queue. (6) Cron: server/src/cron/handlers.ts PLATFORM_CRON_JOBS (351-397) gains brandCronJob('jobs-boards', '*/5 * * * *', 'MKT-3D', [], [{ name: 'boards', run: (budget) => runJobsBoards(budget) }]) (a platform step: it runs once, not per brand); vercel.json crons gains { "path": "/api/v1/cron/jobs-boards", "schedule": "*/5 * * * *" }; regenerate deploy/cn/k8s/cronjobs.yaml with node scripts/gen-cn-cronjobs.mjs; the node-cron mirror follows the table. Kill switch ATS_PUBLIC_SOURCES_DISABLED still stops everything. Line numbers are from the tree before the parity wave merged; re-locate by function name.
ACCEPT: The 'Accepted when' of JI-4: a 728-posting Greenhouse fixture is fully read and handed to the normalizer in one run and none of its stored rows is closed; a scheduler simulation with 1,000 enabled fixture boards and a capacity of 60 boards per 5-minute run reads every changed board within 2 h and every quiet board within 12 h; three consecutive 404 answers disable a source and its rows are archived on the first run 48 h later, while three timeouts do not disable it; two overlapping runs never read the same board (SKIP LOCKED lease); every request carries the identifying User-Agent; GET /api/v1/cron/jobs-boards exists, is listed in vercel.json with the same schedule and in the mainland CronJob file; with the kill switch on the run reports skipped.
TESTS: server/src/features/jobs/ingest/boards.test.ts with a fake db and fake fetch: lease statement (string assertion), concurrency never above the setting, stamp rules, failure classes, the 48 h archive, budget stop, the 1,000-board simulation with a fake clock. server/src/features/jobs/sources/atsPublic/atsPublic.test.ts: 728-posting fixture built in the test (not a 5 MB file), Lever paging to the end. server/src/cron/handlers.platform.test.ts and __tests__/deploy/cronParity.test.ts: the new cron is in the table, in vercel.json and in the generated YAML. server/src/roboapply/schedulers/RoboApplyCronService.test.ts if it enumerates jobs.

[P0] SmartRecruiters: the listing is always read completely, per requested country; posting texts are fetched only for ids not stored yet and continue on later runs (JI-4, JC-4; strategy 1.4 tier 1; critic C9)
CHANGE: server/src/features/jobs/sources/atsPublic/connectors.ts smartrecruiters.read (365-406) stops listing at MAX_POSTINGS_PER_BOARD and reads 100 posting texts per run chosen over the whole board, so a 1,322-posting board is cut off and its closure diff is skipped. New behaviour: (1) Listing: page GET /v1/companies/{id}/postings?limit=100&offset=n until offset + 100 >= totalFound or a short page (safety stop at 200 pages, which marks the listing incomplete). When source.countries is non-empty run one listing pass per code with &country=<lower-case code> and take the union; the listing is complete only when every pass completed. With empty countries one pass without the parameter. The listing gives id, name, location (city, country, remote), releasedDate: enough to decide the market and the closure diff without any detail request. (2) Details (one request per posting, the documented /postings/{id}): only for listed ids that are not among our open rows (opts.known), newest listed first, up to ATS_SR_DETAILS_PER_RUN per board and run (default 100, concurrency 4 as today); when every listed id is stored, the leftover budget refreshes the longest-unrefreshed rows. Only postings whose text was read become inputs. BoardRead gains pendingDetails (listed ids neither stored nor read this run). (3) server/src/features/jobs/ingest/boards.ts: a board with pendingDetails > 0 is made due again at once (nextSyncAt = now) so a large board finishes over successive runs, without waiting for its interval; it is leased after boards that have never been read. (4) Closure: closedExternalIds stays 'open rows absent from a complete listing'; since the listing has no cap any more, no stored posting can be closed for being beyond a cap, and a posting that is listed but not yet detailed is simply not stored yet.
ACCEPT: The SmartRecruiters lines of JI-4, JC-4 and JI-3: a fixture board with 1,300 postings is fully ingested over 13 successive runs at the default budget, its listing is read in full on every run and nothing is closed meanwhile; removing one posting from the fixture closes exactly that row; a BoschGroup fixture with countries ['CN'] requests country=cn on every listing page and lists all of its postings; a source with countries ['TW','CN'] is listed once per country and the two result sets are merged; a failed detail request skips that posting for the run and never fails the board.
TESTS: server/src/features/jobs/sources/atsPublic/atsPublic.test.ts with a generated 1,300-posting listing and a fake fetch that records URLs: paging, per-country parameter, budget, pendingDetails, closure; server/src/features/jobs/ingest/boards.test.ts: the immediate re-lease.
FILES: server/src/features/jobs/sources/atsPublic/connectors.ts, server/src/features/jobs/sources/atsPublic/sync.ts, server/src/features/jobs/sources/atsPublic/shared.ts, server/src/features/jobs/sources/atsPublic/atsPublic.test.ts, server/src/features/jobs/ingest/boards.ts, server/src/features/jobs/ingest/boards.test.ts

[P0] One board read feeds both brands: each posting lands in the market of its own location; a posting located in both is written twice, the mainland copy as <id>#cn (JC-4; strategy 1.4 tier 1; critic C9)
CHANGE: The parity wave made the adapter serve both markets by reading the board once per brand and keeping that brand's rows. With the dedicated sync the board is read once. New server/src/features/jobs/sources/atsPublic/market.ts: splitPostingByMarket(input) -> { intl: ProviderJobInput | null, cn: ProviderJobInput | null } using the same resolver the normalizer uses (parseLocation from server/src/features/jobs/geo/index.ts on input.locations and input.location, with the provider's country as the binding hint for the first location): a location whose country is CN is mainland (HK, MO and TW are not); a posting with only mainland locations -> the cn copy with the plain externalId (what the parity wave already stores); only other or unknown locations, or remote without a country -> the intl copy; locations on both sides -> two inputs: the intl copy keeps the externalId and the non-mainland locations, the cn copy gets externalId + '#cn' and only the mainland locations ((externalId, sourceBoard) is unique, and each row must be in exactly one market). Then apply the source's countries: with a non-empty list a copy is kept only when one of its resolved countries is in the list or it is remote; skipped copies are counted as country_not_selected and never written. If the parity wave left a market rule inside adapter.ts, delete it in favour of this one function. Closure: for every listed posting compute the externalIds it maps to by the same split from the listing data and use that set as listedIds, so a posting that drops its Shanghai location closes its '#cn' row and keeps the other. server/src/features/jobs/ingest/boards.ts calls processJobs once per market with that market's inputs; a market whose brand is not served by the deployment, or whose ingest is switched off (GoApply recruitment-info mode off), has its inputs dropped and counted, not written to the other market. No connector for a Chinese ATS vendor is added here and no career-site HTML is read.
ACCEPT: The 'Accepted when' of JC-4: a Greenhouse fixture posting in 上海 lands in the GoApply index (market cn) and not in RoboApply's; a posting in Singapore from the same board lands in intl; a posting listing Shanghai and Singapore produces 'token:id' in intl with Singapore and 'token:id#cn' in cn with Shanghai; when the fixture later lists only Singapore the '#cn' row is archived as source_removed and the intl row stays open; the fake fetch saw exactly one listing request for the board; with GoApply's ingest off no cn row is written and the tally shows the dropped count.
TESTS: server/src/features/jobs/sources/atsPublic/atsPublic.test.ts (splitPostingByMarket table: mainland only, HK, TW, mixed, remote, unknown; countries filter; listedIds expansion), server/src/features/jobs/ingest/boards.test.ts (two processJobs calls with the right market and brand; closure of a '#cn' row).
FILES: server/src/features/jobs/sources/atsPublic/market.ts (new), server/src/features/jobs/sources/atsPublic/adapter.ts, server/src/features/jobs/sources/atsPublic/sync.ts, server/src/features/jobs/sources/atsPublic/index.ts, server/src/features/jobs/sources/atsPublic/atsPublic.test.ts, server/src/features/jobs/ingest/boards.ts, server/src/features/jobs/ingest/boards.test.ts

[P0] Discovery: every ingested or imported row that links to an ATS board names a candidate source; a candidate is enabled only after a list-only read that matches (JI-3; strategy 1.2 company list (1), (4); INTL note 4.5, 8.1 M3)
CHANGE: New server/src/features/jobs/sources/atsPublic/discovery.ts. (1) Collect: server/src/features/jobs/sources/atsPublic/hooks.ts atsPublicHooks (155-192): appliesTo also accepts stage 'ingest' and 'import' for any market and provider; afterNormalize, after withAtsSourceName, calls noteDiscoveredBoard(job). It reads job.atsPostingKey ('<ats>:<tenant>:<postingId>', written by MKT-3C's normalizer; absent or malformed -> no-op, so this bundle works before that one merges), ignores provider 'ats_public' (already a source), accepts ats in the readable list (greenhouse, lever, ashby, smartrecruiters) plus 'workable' and 'lever_eu' (stored as candidates for MKT-5B's connectors), checks the tenant against the board-token pattern /^[A-Za-z0-9_.-]{1,120}$/, and inserts with createMany({ skipDuplicates: true }): { market: job.market, ats, boardToken: tenant, companyName: job.companyName, origin: 'discovered', discoveredFrom: '<sourceBoard>:<externalId>' (for a user import just 'user_import': no user id, no URL), enabled: false, countries: [] }. A per-process LRU of 5,000 keys avoids repeat inserts; a database error is swallowed and counted (a card and an ingest run never fail because of discovery). The user's imported job itself stays private; only the public board token is recorded. (2) Validate: server/src/features/jobs/ingest/boards.ts runs validateCandidates(db, limit) once per run before the sync loop (ATS_DISCOVERY_VALIDATIONS_PER_RUN, default 20): sources with enabled false, origin in ('discovered','import'), lastSyncedAt null and disabledAt null, oldest first. For each: connectorFor(ats).read(source, deps, { listOnly: true }); it passes when the listing has at least one posting AND the company matches: where the API states the board's company (Greenhouse GET /v1/boards/{token} -> name, one extra documented request; SmartRecruiters listing items carry company.name) the normalised names must be equal or one must contain the other; where it states none (Lever, Ashby) the token must equal the slug of the candidate's normalised company name or of its employer domain's first label. Pass -> enabled true, nextSyncAt null. Fail -> stays disabled with lastSyncedAt now and lastError 'validation:<empty_board | name_mismatch | name_unconfirmed | board_not_found | …>' so it is not retried every run; an admin can still enable it by hand. An ats without a connector yet is left untouched for MKT-5B.

CHANGE: Data files next to the parity wave's server/src/features/jobs/sources/atsPublic/seeds.cn.json: server/src/features/jobs/sources/atsPublic/seeds.tw.json and server/src/features/jobs/sources/atsPublic/seeds.intl.json, one loader server/src/features/jobs/sources/atsPublic/seeds.ts (generalise the parity loader). Entry shape: { ats, boardToken, companyName, countries: string[], note: '<research note and section>', confirmedOn: 'YYYY-MM-DD' }. Contents are ONLY boards a research note names as confirmed live (never add a tenant from memory). Taiwan, from JOB_SOURCES_TW.md 3.5 (confirmed 2026-10-11): greenhouse coupang (Coupang), ubiquiti (Ubiquiti), appier (Appier), canonical (Canonical), asteralabs (Astera Labs), stripe (Stripe), okx (OKX), dcard (Dcard); lever binance (Binance), piccollage (PicCollage), shopback-2 (ShopBack), crypto (Crypto.com); ashby kraken.com (Kraken); smartrecruiters BoschGroup (Bosch). Mainland, from MARKET_STRATEGY 1.1 (critic-pass probes): smartrecruiters BoschGroup (1,322 postings with country=cn) and Ubisoft2 (13); keep every entry the parity engineer verified in seeds.cn.json. International, from JOB_SOURCES_INTL.md 3.2: greenhouse stripe, ashby ramp. Countries: single-call boards (Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby) are seeded with an empty list (every country: reading the whole board costs one request), SmartRecruiters boards with explicit codes because each country is a separate listing: BoschGroup is ONE entry with ['TW','CN'] and Ubisoft2 has ['CN']. Ubisoft2's companyName is the token until the first sync reads the name the API states. The loader merges the three files by (ats, boardToken) (union of countries; empty wins), upserts rows with origin 'seed' and enabled true, never overwrites an admin's later edits of enabled or companyName, and runs at the start of a board sync only when the hash of the merged seed differs from AppConfig key 'jobs.careerSeeds.v1' (then stores the new hash). Reaching 50 mainland-hiring boards before GoApply's production launch is an operations task through bulk import and discovery, not a list to invent here.
ACCEPT: The 'Accepted when' of JT-5 (seed half): after the loader runs, the 14 Taiwan boards exist as sources that cover TW (sourceCoversCountry: an explicit TW code or the empty list), and BoschGroup is one row whose countries are exactly TW and CN; running the loader twice writes nothing the second time; an admin who disabled a seeded board finds it still disabled after a deploy; the test fails if an entry is added without a note, with a duplicate (ats, token), with an unknown ATS, a token outside the pattern or a non-ISO country.
TESTS: server/src/features/jobs/sources/atsPublic/seeds.test.ts (new): shape and uniqueness across the three files, the exact Taiwan token set pinned to the list above, BoschGroup merge, loader idempotence and the admin-edit rule with a fake db and fake AppConfig.

schema: model RACareerSiteSource (server/prisma/schema/ra-jobs.prisma), additive: origin String @default("admin") /// 'admin' | 'seed' | 'import' | 'discovered'
model RACareerSiteSource, additive: discoveredFrom String? /// for origin 'discovered': '<sourceBoard>:<externalId>' of the row that named the board, or 'user_import'
model RACareerSiteSource, additive: countries String[] @default([]) /// ISO alpha-2 codes the board is read for; empty = every country the brands serve
model RACareerSiteSource, additive: failCount Int @default(0) /// consecutive hard sync failures; 3 disables the source
model RACareerSiteSource, additive: lastChangeAt DateTime? /// when a sync last added or closed a posting (adaptive interval)
model RACareerSiteSource, additive: nextSyncAt DateTime? /// when the board is next due; null = now; also the sync lease
model RACareerSiteSource, additive: disabledAt DateTime? /// set when three failures disabled the source; its rows are archived 48 h later
model RACareerSiteSource, additive index: @@index([enabled, nextSyncAt])
Everything above is delivered by MKT-0 in phase M0 (see its schema array for the exact Prisma text); this bundle never edits *.prisma and never runs a push.
env: ATS_BOARDS_CONCURRENCY: board listings read in flight by the board sync, clamped to 4-8 (6)
ATS_SR_DETAILS_PER_RUN: SmartRecruiters posting texts read per board and run (100)
ATS_DISCOVERY_VALIDATIONS_PER_RUN: candidate sources validated per board-sync run (20)
ATS_PUBLIC_SOURCES_DISABLED: existing kill switch for every public job-board read (false)

bundles.title: Taiwan: 台灣就業通 open-data adapter with a resumable sweep and attribution, zh-Hant role labels, 通俗職業 map, import denylist
items:
[P0] Taiwan district table (county code, 3-digit postal code, names) that drives the sweep (JT-2, JT-7 preparation; strategy 1.3; TW note 3.1, 5.3)
CHANGE: The open-data API has no paging and a 1,000-row cap; a capped county is split by zipno (the first three digits of the postal code, one 鄉鎮市區). New server/src/features/jobs/geo/twDistricts.json { version, asOf, source: { name, publisher, url, license, retrievedOn }, counties: [{ code, name, nameAlt }], districts: [{ zip3, countyCode, county, district }] } and server/src/features/jobs/geo/twDistricts.ts (typed accessors: TW_COUNTIES, districtsOfCounty(code), districtByZip(zip3), findTwDistrict(text) which splits strings such as '新竹縣竹北市', '臺北市士林區' or '台中市不限' into county and district, accepting both 台 and 臺; validateTwDistricts for the test). The 22 county codes come from the interface document as listed in JOB_SOURCES_TW.md 3.1: 01 台北市, 31 新北市, 11 基隆市, 33 桃園市, 12 新竹市, 34 新竹縣, 35 苗栗縣, 13 台中市, 38 南投縣, 37 彰化縣, 39 雲林縣, 14 嘉義市, 40 嘉義縣, 15 台南市, 02 高雄市, 43 屏東縣, 32 宜蘭縣, 45 花蓮縣, 46 台東縣, 44 澎湖縣, 23 金門縣, 24 連江縣. The district rows must be built from an official published list (the open-data interface document if it carries the zipno table, otherwise 中華郵政's 3-digit postal code list), with the source URL, its licence and the retrieval date written into the file's source block; never type postal codes from memory (D3). If no official list can be retrieved in the session, commit the file with the 22 counties and an empty districts array and say so in the handoff: the sweep then uses its fallback split (next item) and ops supplies the list later. Export the module from server/src/features/jobs/geo/index.ts. Nothing here changes parseLocation or the city table (MKT-5F adds the district level to job rows).
ACCEPT: validateTwDistricts reports no problem: 22 counties with unique two-digit codes, every district zip3 is three digits and unique, every district belongs to a listed county, the source block is filled; findTwDistrict('新竹縣竹北市') returns county 新竹縣 and district 竹北市 and '台中市不限' returns the county with no district; with an empty districts array the accessors return empty lists and nothing throws.
TESTS: server/src/features/jobs/geo/twDistricts.test.ts (shape, uniqueness, the 22 codes pinned to the list above, the split cases; no network).

[P0] 台灣就業通 adapter: request, field mapping, pay only from the numeric fields (JT-2; strategy M-5, 1.3; TW note 3.1, 6 items 1-2)
CHANGE: Replace the guarded stub server/src/features/jobs/sources/twOpenData.ts (TW_OPEN_DATA_LICENCE_CONFIRMED false at line 24, twOpenDataStatus 33-38) with a JobSourceAdapter: provider 'tw_open_data' (declared in MKT-1C), kind 'cursor', markets ['intl'], sourceBoards ['tw_open_data'], costModel 'free', supportsCountry = TW only, dailyCallLimit null. The licence (政府資料開放授權條款 第1版) is confirmed by reading (strategy 8), so the adapter is ON by default: enabled unless TW_OPEN_DATA_JOBS_ENABLED is explicitly false / 0 / off; rewrite the header. Request: GET <TW_OPEN_DATA_JOBS_URL, default https://free.taiwanjobs.gov.tw/webservice_taipei/Webservice.ashx>?CITY=<code>&COUNT=1000&T=CSV, optionally &zipno=<3 digits> and &jobno=<2-digit 大類>; https only, redirect 'error', 20 s timeout, response cap 8 MB, header User-Agent = sourceUserAgent('intl', env) (MKT-1C). Parse the CSV with csv-parse; column headers carry the Chinese label in full-width brackets (for example 'OCCU_DESC（職務名稱）'): match on the ASCII part before the bracket. Mapping per row: title = OCCU_DESC; company = COMPNAME; description = JOB_DETAIL (plain text); applyUrl = sourceUrl = URL_QUERY (the vacancy page on job.taiwanjobs.gov.tw; the user applies there, D1); externalId = 'tw:<EMPLOYER_ID>:<HIRE_ID>' read from URL_QUERY's query string, and a row without both is skipped and counted (no_stable_id), never given an invented id; location = CITYNAME with locationCountry 'TW' (binding); employmentType from WK_TYPE (全職 -> full time, 兼職 -> part time); postedAt = TRANDATE (it is the update date: set postedAtEstimated true so cards say last verified, not posted); expiresAt = STOP_DATE (YYYYMMDD, end of that day in Taipei time, UTC+8); experience from EXPERIENCE ('無' / '不拘' -> 0 years, 'N年以上' -> minimum N); education from EDGRDESC through the education input the parity wave added (不拘 -> none, 專科 -> associate, 大學 -> bachelor, 碩士 -> master, 博士 -> phd, anything else unset); taxonomyId from CJOB2_COUNT through the 通俗職業 map (item 6); sourcePublisher '台灣就業通'. Pay: salaryMin / salaryMax ONLY from numeric NT_L / NT_U (currency TWD; period from SALARYCD: 月薪 and 部分工時(月薪) -> month, 時薪 -> hour, 日薪 -> day, 論件計酬 -> no period and no figure); when NT_L / NT_U are '-' or not numbers pass SALARYCD verbatim as salaryText with no figure (MKT-1C made that sentence 'negotiable, no figure'). Never store or infer the statutory threshold. No logo, no contact fields, no English are available: leave them empty.
ACCEPT: With a fixture response: a 月薪 row gives 30,000-38,000 TWD a month, disclosed; the row whose SALARYCD is '依學經歷、證照核薪(每月經常性薪資達4萬元以上)' and whose NT_L / NT_U are '-' gives no figure, salaryDisclosed false and that text; STOP_DATE 20261231 gives expiresAt 2026-12-31T15:59:59Z; a row whose URL lacks HIRE_ID is skipped and counted; every input has provider country TW, publisher 台灣就業通 and the vacancy URL as apply link; with TW_OPEN_DATA_JOBS_ENABLED=false the adapter reports disabled and fetches nothing; no test touches the network.
TESTS: server/src/features/jobs/sources/twOpenData.test.ts with fixtures under server/src/features/jobs/sources/__fixtures__/tw/ (a few rows per shape: record them with one manual request to the open-data endpoint and trim to five rows, or, without network, hand-build them from the documented field list and mark the README SYNTHETIC): header matching, every mapping above, the skip tally, the kill switch, a non-200 answer and an oversized body return an error result without throwing.
FILES: server/src/features/jobs/sources/twOpenData.ts, server/src/features/jobs/sources/twOpenData.test.ts, server/src/features/jobs/sources/__fixtures__/tw/* (new)

[P0] Resumable sweep cursor (county -> district -> 大類), one sweep a day, closure after two complete sweeps without the row (JT-2; strategy 1.3, 1.5; critic C12)
CHANGE: A full sweep is a few hundred sequential requests and cannot finish in one 300 s function run. The adapter's standing query (created by ensureBankSyncQueries for every cursor adapter of the market) keeps params.cursor = JSON text { v: 1, sweepStartedAt, prevSweepStartedAt, lastCompleteSweepStartedAt, county: index into the 22 codes, zip: index or null, jobno: index or null, incomplete: boolean, counts }. One fetch performs at most TW_OPEN_DATA_REQUESTS_PER_FETCH requests (default 5), strictly sequential with TW_OPEN_DATA_PAUSE_MS between them (default 1500), then returns the rows read, the advanced cursor and exhausted: false; the ingest tick re-leases it while budget remains (MKT-3A caps a cursor source's share of a tick), so the sweep resumes at the same county, district and 大類 on the next run. Split rule: request the county; when it returns 1,000 rows (the cap) discard nothing but walk that county's districts from twDistricts (zipno); when a district returns 1,000, walk the 22 大類 codes ('01'-'22') for that district with jobno; when a (district, 大類) leaf still returns 1,000, keep its rows, set incomplete true and count tw_capped_leaf. Fallback when the district table is empty: split a capped county by the 22 大類 instead and mark a still-capped leaf the same way. A request error leaves the cursor where it was (retry on the next fetch) and after three consecutive errors at the same position the sweep is marked incomplete and moves on. When the last county is done: if the sweep is not incomplete, store lastCompleteSweepStartedAt; the adapter then answers { jobs: [], calls: 0, exhausted: true } without any request until 24 h after sweepStartedAt, when a new sweep starts (TW_OPEN_DATA_SWEEP_HOURS, default 24). Closure: when a complete sweep ends and the previous complete sweep exists, rows with sourceBoard 'tw_open_data', market intl, visibility public, archivedAt null and lastSeenAt older than the start of the previous complete sweep were absent from two consecutive complete sweeps: return up to 5,000 of their externalIds as closedExternalIds with closeReason 'source_removed' (read through deps.db, the lazy Prisma import the ats_public adapter uses); an incomplete sweep closes nothing. Rows also expire on STOP_DATE through expiresAt (MKT-3C). Register the adapter: new server/src/features/jobs/sources/register.ts (side-effect module, idempotent like atsPublic/register.ts) registers tw_open_data; it is imported by server/src/features/jobs/sources/twHooks.ts, which server/src/features/jobs/marketHooks.ts imports statically, so the adapter is in the registry before any plan or ingest run.
ACCEPT: The 'Accepted when' of JT-2: a fixture sweep in which county 01 returns 1,000 rows is split by district, and a capped district by 大類; a run cut off after its request budget returns exhausted false and the next fetch resumes at the same county and district (the cursor round-trips through JSON); after a complete sweep the adapter makes no request for 24 h; a row seen in sweep 1 and absent from complete sweeps 2 and 3 is returned as closed at the end of sweep 3, and is not closed when sweep 3 was incomplete; requests are never concurrent and each carries the User-Agent; adaptersForBrand(roboapply) includes tw_open_data and adaptersForBrand(goapply) does not.
TESTS: server/src/features/jobs/sources/twOpenData.test.ts with a scripted fake fetch and fake clock: split decisions, resume, error handling, daily cadence, closure query (fake db) and the incomplete rule; a registry test that importing marketHooks registers the adapter once.
FILES: server/src/features/jobs/sources/twOpenData.ts, server/src/features/jobs/sources/twOpenData.test.ts, server/src/features/jobs/sources/register.ts (new), server/src/features/jobs/sources/twHooks.ts (new), server/src/features/jobs/marketHooks.ts

[P0] OGDL attribution on every open-data row, in the API and on the card (JT-2; strategy 1.3; TW note 3.1, 6 item 3)
CHANGE: The licence voids itself without attribution, and the constant in the stub is short of what its Exhibit asks for (provider, year, dataset name, licence statement). server/src/features/jobs/sources/twHooks.ts: a MarketHookSet with id 'tw_sources', appliesTo = market intl and sourceBoard in a table TW_OPEN_DATA_ATTRIBUTIONS keyed by sourceBoard: tw_open_data -> (year) => '資料來源：勞動部勞動力發展署 ' + year + '「台灣就業通網站職缺清單」，依政府資料開放授權條款第1版公開釋出'; tw_gov_jobs -> (year) => '資料來源：行政院人事行政總處 ' + year + '「行政院人事行政總處事求人機關徵才資料」，依政府資料開放授權條款第1版公開釋出' (dataset 7229; unused until MKT-5D ships that adapter). cardMeta returns { attribution: { text, url: 'https://data.gov.tw/license' } } where year is the Taipei-time year of the row's lastSeenAt (or of now when the row has none); afterNormalize sets sourceName to the dataset's publisher label and leaves originalSourceName empty (the dataset is the original source). The sentences are data, not UI copy: they live in this server file in Traditional Chinese for every locale, and the 台灣就業通 logo is never used (trademarks are outside the licence). Add the set to MARKET_HOOK_SETS in server/src/features/jobs/marketHooks.ts (line 51). Web: components/features/market/tw/meta.ts reads meta.tw_sources defensively (readTwSourcesMeta, same style as readTwMeta) and components/features/market/tw/JobMetaTw.tsx renders the attribution sentence as a link to the licence URL (rel noopener noreferrer, safeHref) on the card and on the job page for these rows; no new i18n string is needed because the visible text is the attribution itself. Public display of these rows stays governed by PUBLIC_DISPLAY_PROVIDERS (owner decision OPS-A4); this item only guarantees the attribution wherever the row is shown.
ACCEPT: For a tw_open_data row last seen in 2026 the card meta carries exactly the sentence above with 2026 and the licence link, in every locale; a Greenhouse row in Taiwan carries none; the web card for such a row renders the sentence as a link and nothing when the meta is missing or malformed; no 台灣就業通 logo asset is referenced; npm run check passes (no copy-gate hit, the text is server data).
TESTS: server/src/features/jobs/sources/twHooks.test.ts (sentence and year, the two datasets, non-matching rows), components/features/market/tw/__tests__/jobMetaTw.attribution.test.tsx (renders, link target, absent meta).
FILES: server/src/features/jobs/sources/twHooks.ts (new), server/src/features/jobs/sources/twHooks.test.ts (new), server/src/features/jobs/marketHooks.ts, components/features/market/tw/meta.ts, components/features/market/tw/JobMetaTw.tsx, components/features/market/tw/__tests__/jobMetaTw.attribution.test.tsx (new)

[P1] Traditional Chinese labels and synonyms for the role tree (JT-4, SM-11; strategy 2.1 item 2, 2.5; TW note 5.1, 6 item 5)
CHANGE: server/src/features/jobs/taxonomy/taxonomy.v1.json has en and zh only, so zh-TW users see English role names and Taiwan queries cannot be built. Add to every one of the 307 nodes a zhHant label, and to every role (level 3) synonyms.zhHant. These are translations in Taiwan usage, not conversions of the Simplified label: 軟體 (not 软件 / 軟件), 資料 (not 数据), 網路, 程式, 專案, 行銷, 人資, 韌體, 演算法, 產品經理, 工程師, 專員, 助理, 儲備幹部. Add at file level zhHantReview: { status: 'draft', reviewedBy: null, reviewedOn: null } (a Taiwan-native reviewer signs off later: owner item 19; the labels ship as draft because zh-TW otherwise shows English). server/src/features/jobs/taxonomy/taxonomy.ts: make zhHant required in TaxonomyNode now that the data has it; validateTaxonomy (125-149) requires a non-empty zhHant on every node; a test additionally checks every zhHant label and synonym against the terms the variant glossary bans for zh-TW (i18n/glossary/zh-variants.json, the list scripts/check-zh-variants.mjs enforces on bundles; the taxonomy file is not a bundle, so the test reads the glossary itself); taxonomyLabel(id, 'zh-TW') returns zhHant. server/src/features/jobs/taxonomy/match.ts: index the zhHant synonyms next to zh ones so a Traditional title matches without relying only on the variant folding. Add exportTaxonomyLabels(locale) in server/src/features/jobs/taxonomy/taxonomy.ts returning the object shape of the web bundle's taxonomy namespace ({ roles, groups, categories }) so the orchestrator's locale step can fill i18n/messages/zh-TW.json from this file instead of machine-translating role names a second time (the messages files are not edited by this bundle; say so in the handoff). The planner (MKT-3B) reads node.zhHant for Taiwan queries.
ACCEPT: The 'Accepted when' of JT-4, first half: taxonomyLabel('software_engineer', 'zh-TW') returns '軟體工程師' and never a Simplified string; validateTaxonomy passes for the shipped file and fails for a node without zhHant; no zhHant label or synonym contains a term the glossary bans for zh-TW; a title '資深軟體工程師' maps to the software engineer role; exportTaxonomyLabels('zh-TW') has one entry per node; ids, en and zh labels and the node count (307) are unchanged; npm run check:zh-variants passes.
TESTS: server/src/features/jobs/taxonomy/taxonomy.test.ts (labels, validation, export shape, no id drift: snapshot of the id list), server/src/features/jobs/taxonomy/match.test.ts (Traditional titles).

bundles.title: Runbooks and pre-flight: Alipay cut-over with the notify check, Stripe test-mode pass (documents and one script)
items:
[P0] Pre-flight script: does the resolved notify host answer with OUR callback JSON? (AL-8 code side; MARKET_STRATEGY 5.3 cut-over checklist steps 2 and 5, C1)
CHANGE: New scripts/alipay-notify-preflight.mjs (plain Node 24, no dependency). It resolves the GoApply notify origin with the same precedence as alipayNotifyOrigin in server/src/platform/billing/origins.ts (MKT-2A): the --origin argument, else CN_ALIPAY_NOTIFY_ORIGIN, else CN_BACKEND_URL, else https://www.goapply.top (export the resolver so the test can compare it with the server function); then sends ONE GET to <origin>/api/v1/roboapply/billing/alipay/callback with no parameters and no secret, and prints: the host, the HTTP status, and PASS when the body is our JSON refusal ({ code: 40001 } with HTTP 400, { code: 40003 } with HTTP 403, or { code: 50003 } with HTTP 503 = route reached but ALIPAY_CALLBACK_SECRET not set there, reported as PASS-ROUTE / FAIL-SECRET), FAIL for a 401 (deployment protection), a 404, an HTML page, a redirect to another host, or a timeout (10 s). Exit code 0 only on PASS. It sends no order number, never sends or prints the callback secret, creates nothing, and is safe to run against production. The fetch function is injectable for the test. Add the usage line to the script header: node scripts/alipay-notify-preflight.mjs [--origin https://…].
ACCEPT: (section 9, AL-8) The pre-flight script reports our JSON answer from the resolved notify host. Added: with an empty env it checks www.goapply.top; --origin wins; a 401, a 404, an HTML body and a redirect each report FAIL with the reason; 50003 reports that the route is reached and the secret is missing; BACKEND_URL is never read; the resolver equals the server's for the same env.
TESTS: __tests__/scripts/alipayNotifyPreflight.test.ts (new; injected fetch stub, no network): each outcome, and resolver parity with alipayNotifyOrigin for a table of env values.
FILES: scripts/alipay-notify-preflight.mjs, __tests__/scripts/alipayNotifyPreflight.test.ts

[P0] Alipay cut-over runbook (AL-8 document; MARKET_STRATEGY 5.3 "Cut-over checklist", section 7 items 5-8a). The supervised order itself is owner-only.
CHANGE: New docs/jobright-clone/market/ALIPAY_CUTOVER.md, written for the owner and an operator, nothing invented (D3). Contents: (1) What must be true before the day: goapply.top serves this code and the database that creates GoApply orders; roboapply.io is NOT pointed at the clone before that (M-18); ALIPAY_CALLBACK_SECRET decision (is it set in Vercel production today? reuse the value; if not: set it on main first and wait out the cashier's order lifetime, or set ALIPAY_SECRETLESS_UNTIL to the deploy instant, which closes by itself 7 days later). (2) Environment table for the test deployment and for production: ALIPAY_CALLBACK_SECRET, CN_ALIPAY_NOTIFY_ORIGIN (the deployment's own public origin; never roboapply.io while it runs main), CN_PAYMENT_COLLECTING_ENTITY (the merchant's legal name once the owner supplies it), CN_ALIPAY_PACKAGE_ID_MODE, CN_PAYMENTS_ENABLED as the kill switch. (3) The five steps of section 5.3 as a checklist with the exact commands: the pre-flight (script above; a Vercel preview behind Deployment Protection answers 401, use a public alias); buy one 会员周卡 (¥12) with the owner present; capture the worker's raw callback (method, query, body) from the request log; confirm activation and the receipt; refund in the merchant console and record it in the admin console (AL-7; that action is built one phase later (M4) by MKT-4B and MKT-4C, so describe it from their contract and mark the step "available after phase M4": POST /api/v1/roboapply/admin/credits/cn-orders/:orderId/refund with the reason and the confirmation that the money was returned). (4) What to read from the captured callback and what to change afterwards: did cb come back; is total_amount yuan with decimals or fen (then tighten the tolerance of AL-4 in a follow-up); did the worker accept the plan key as package_id (else set CN_ALIPAY_PACKAGE_ID_MODE=legacy). (5) A form to attach: date, deployment URL, order number, the captured callback with the secret redacted, activation time, refund reference. (6) Rollback: CN_PAYMENTS_ENABLED=false stops new orders at once; pending orders still fulfil. (7) The twelve rules A1-A12 as a one-page list with the test file that pins each.
