bundles.title: Closure and freshness: on-demand liveness check, three date facts, mainland unseen rule, sponsorship label rule
items:
[P0] Liveness check against the ATS's documented single-posting endpoint (JI-10; strategy 1.5 closure; INTL note 7.2, 8.2 S5)
CHANGE: New server/src/features/jobs/liveness/ (index.ts, check.ts, check.test.ts). checkPostingLive(job, deps) -> { state: 'open' | 'closed' | 'unknown', checkedAt, via } for a row that has an atsPostingKey (MKT-3C) of one of the three ATSs whose public API documents a single-posting JSON endpoint: greenhouse -> GET https://boards-api.greenhouse.io/v1/boards/{token}/jobs/{id}; lever -> GET https://api.lever.co/v0/postings/{site}/{id} (lever_eu on api.eu.lever.co once MKT-5B allows the host; until then unknown); smartrecruiters -> GET https://api.smartrecruiters.com/v1/companies/{id}/postings/{postingId}. Use getJson from server/src/features/jobs/sources/atsPublic/http.ts (allow-listed hosts, no redirects, identifying User-Agent) with a 4 s timeout. 200 with a posting -> open; 404 -> closed; anything else (timeout, 5xx, 429, unexpected shape) -> unknown. Never an HTML fetch, never a career-site page, never Workday or any ATS outside the table (those answer unknown without a request). The check applies to any provider's row that carries such a key (a JSearch row linking to Greenhouse included). Throttle: skip the request and answer from the row when lastSeenAt is under 6 hours old (LIVENESS_RECHECK_HOURS) or when an in-process LRU has an answer for the key younger than 10 minutes; at most one request per job per call. Effects, through one function applyLiveness(db, job, result): open -> set lastSeenAt = now (it is 'last confirmed listed'); closed -> archive the row (archivedAt, closedAt, closeReason 'source_removed') and run the dedupe repair for its key so an alternate becomes canonical; unknown -> no write. Kill switch LIVENESS_CHECK_DISABLED.
ACCEPT: A row keyed 'greenhouse:acme:1' whose endpoint answers 404 is reported closed and archived with closeReason source_removed; 200 refreshes lastSeenAt; a timeout or 500 reports unknown and writes nothing; a row seen 2 hours ago makes no request; a Workday-keyed row makes no request; the request URL is built only from the stored key (asserted) and goes only to the three hosts.
TESTS: server/src/features/jobs/liveness/check.test.ts with a fake fetch and fake db: per-ATS URL, status mapping, throttles, effects, kill switch.
FILES: server/src/features/jobs/liveness/index.ts (new), server/src/features/jobs/liveness/check.ts (new), server/src/features/jobs/liveness/check.test.ts (new)

[P0] Opening a job confirms it is still listed and shows "closed" instead of a dead link (JI-10; strategy 1.5)
CHANGE: server/src/features/jobs/detail/service.ts: in get (JobDetailServiceImpl, 158-171) after loadJob (211-219), when the row is public, open and carries an eligible atsPostingKey, run checkPostingLive with a soft wrapper (the existing soft() helper: a failure never fails the page) and apply the result before the view is built, so a posting the board dropped an hour ago is returned with status 'closed' (view.ts isClosed, line 154; status at 293) and no apply call to action; the feed stops listing it because it is archived. recordApplyClick (495-499) runs the same check first and answers the existing 409 job_closed when the posting is gone, so the user is never sent to a dead page and nothing moves to Applied. server/src/features/jobs/detail/contract.ts: the detail view gains listing: { checkedAt: string | null, via: 'ats_api' | 'sync' | null } next to status. A user's private import and a bank job are never checked this way (the bank tombstone closes those). Web: components/features/job/JobHeader.tsx and JobDetailPanel.tsx show, for status closed, a plain line that the employer's board no longer lists the job (existing closed state; add the sentence that says when it was last listed, from lastSeenAt) and hide the apply button; strings in i18n/staging/jobDetail.en.json.
ACCEPT: The 'Accepted when' of JI-10: opening a job whose ATS endpoint answers 404 shows it closed and archives it (the API returns status 'closed', the page shows the closed line and no apply button, a second open makes no request); an apply click on such a job answers 409 job_closed and creates no tracker move; when the check is unavailable the job opens exactly as today; npm run check passes for the new copy.
TESTS: server/src/features/jobs/detail/detail.test.ts (get and recordApplyClick with a faked liveness dependency: closed, open, unknown, private import untouched), components/features/job/job.test.tsx (closed rendering).
FILES: server/src/features/jobs/detail/service.ts, server/src/features/jobs/detail/defaultService.ts, server/src/features/jobs/detail/view.ts, server/src/features/jobs/detail/contract.ts, server/src/features/jobs/detail/detail.test.ts, components/features/job/JobHeader.tsx, components/features/job/JobDetailPanel.tsx, components/features/job/job.test.tsx, i18n/staging/jobDetail.en.json

[P1] "Ready to apply" checks the posting before a kit is prepared (JI-10; strategy 1.5; D1)
CHANGE: server/src/features/agent/deps.ts (the seams Ready to apply calls, lazily imported public surfaces only): add checkJobLive(jobId): Promise<'open' | 'closed' | 'unknown'> backed by the jobs/liveness public index (it loads the row, runs checkPostingLive and applies the result). server/src/features/agent/service.ts: call it where a job enters the Ready queue and again at the start of preparation, before the existing isJobClosed test (store.ts 172-173; the job_closed transitions at service.ts 673 and 1043): a closed answer follows the existing 'job_closed' path (the item expires, the ready_kits reservation is released, the user is told the job closed); unknown proceeds as today. The check makes one documented JSON request to the ATS's public posting API and never touches an employer's application form (D1 is unchanged: nothing is submitted).
ACCEPT: Adding a job whose posting endpoint answers 404 to the Ready queue is refused with the existing job_closed result and no credit is spent; a kit whose job closes between queueing and preparation expires with job_closed and its reservation is released; with the check unavailable the flow is unchanged.
TESTS: server/src/features/agent/__tests__/liveness.test.ts (new) with the agent's fakes: enqueue and prepare paths for closed / open / unknown.
FILES: server/src/features/agent/deps.ts, server/src/features/agent/service.ts, server/src/features/agent/__tests__/liveness.test.ts (new), server/src/features/jobs/liveness/index.ts

[P1] Three separate date facts everywhere; "New" means first seen by us; an undated posting says "last verified" (JI-10; strategy 1.5 dates; INTL note 7.2)
CHANGE: The row already keeps postedAt (the employer's date, with postedAtEstimated), firstSeenAt (ours) and lastSeenAt (last confirmed listed). Make every surface use them consistently. server/src/features/feed/contract.ts and items.ts (lastSeenAt at 150, postedAtEstimated at 149): the feed item gains firstSeenAt and isNew. ItemContext (items.ts 117-128) gains an optional newSince?: Date | null (the viewer's previous visit, the instant the new-count query already uses); isNew = firstSeenAt is after newSince when the caller supplies it, else after now minus 48 hours (constant NEW_WINDOW_HOURS); it is never derived from postedAt. server/src/features/feed/FeedQueryService.ts is owned by this bundle in M5 for this one change: where it builds the ItemContext for its items it passes the viewer's previous-visit instant (the value the new-count query already uses) as newSince; a caller with no previous visit passes null and the 48-hour rule applies, which is still 'first seen by us'. Nothing else in FeedQueryService.ts changes (the retrieval and ranking code of MKT-4F stays as merged). isNew is an item field, not an entry of the badges list (that list is capped at three), and the card model shows its existing 'new' badge from it. server/src/features/jobs/detail/view.ts and contract.ts expose firstSeenAt too. Web: components/features/feed/cardModel.ts builds the date line from these facts: a real postedAt -> 'Posted {relative}'; postedAtEstimated -> 'Last verified {date}' from lastSeenAt (never 'posted'; 台灣就業通 rows and undated mainland rows land here); the New badge only from isNew; JobCard.tsx and JobHeader.tsx render what the model says. A 40-day-old posting first seen today therefore shows its true posted date and a New badge, which is honest for employer boards (their median age is 40 days). Existing strings are reused where they exist ('Last checked'); any new wording goes to i18n/staging/jobDetail.en.json; the card's namespace is not edited by this bundle (if a card string is missing, request it in the handoff).
ACCEPT: A board posting published 300 days ago and first seen an hour ago shows 'Posted 300 days ago' and the New badge; an open-data row (estimated date) shows 'Last verified' with its lastSeenAt and never the word posted; a row first seen before the supplied newSince (or, without one, more than 48 hours ago) has isNew false whatever its posted date; the feed item and the detail view carry all three dates as ISO strings.
TESTS: server/src/features/feed/items.test.ts (firstSeenAt, isNew), server/src/features/jobs/detail/detail.test.ts (view fields), components/features/feed/cardModel.test.ts (the three date-line cases, the badge), server/src/features/feed/FeedQueryService.test.ts (items built after a visit carry isNew only for rows first seen after that visit; without a visit the 48-hour rule).
FILES: server/src/features/feed/contract.ts, server/src/features/feed/items.ts, server/src/features/feed/items.test.ts, server/src/features/jobs/detail/view.ts, server/src/features/jobs/detail/contract.ts, components/features/feed/cardModel.ts, components/features/feed/cardModel.test.ts, components/features/feed/JobCard.tsx, components/features/job/JobHeader.tsx, server/src/features/feed/FeedQueryService.ts, server/src/features/feed/FeedQueryService.test.ts

[P1] Mainland rows close by validity, disappearance, or 45 days unseen; missed-refresh tracking stays for aggregators only (JI-10; strategy 1.5 closure, M-22; CN note 8 item 5)
CHANGE: server/src/features/jobs/ingest/maintain.ts runMaintenance (185-207): add step unseenMainland: archive public market 'cn' rows whose lastSeenAt is older than 45 days (constant CN_UNSEEN_DAYS) with closeReason 'expired', for every sourceBoard except user imports; this is the fallback for a mainland source that stopped being read (a disabled board, a bank job the transport no longer returns), after stated validity (expiresAt, MKT-3C) and disappearance from a complete listing (board sync, bank tombstones). It never applies to market intl board or bank rows, which have no age or unseen cut-off. server/src/features/jobs/ingest/tracking.ts: the per-query missed-twice rule (buildMissedSql, 91-100) keeps applying only to metered search providers; confirm in a test that rows of ats_public, the banks, tw_open_data, tw_gov_jobs and usajobs are never selected by it and document in the header that the SR-16b-1 columns now exist in the schema (the probe at 51-66 returns true after the M0 push). Report the new count in MaintainResult.
ACCEPT: A market cn board row not seen for 46 days is archived as expired and one seen 44 days ago is not; an intl board row not seen for 60 days is untouched by this step; a jsearch row missed by two later counted runs inside its window is still archived as source_removed and a board row never is.
TESTS: server/src/features/jobs/ingest/maintain.test.ts (the new statement and its market scope; MaintainResult), a new server/src/features/jobs/ingest/tracking.test.ts for the provider scope of the missed-twice rule.
FILES: server/src/features/jobs/ingest/maintain.ts, server/src/features/jobs/ingest/maintain.test.ts, server/src/features/jobs/ingest/tracking.ts, server/src/features/jobs/ingest/tracking.test.ts (new)

[P1] A job is labelled as sponsoring only with the posting's own quote or as a labelled provider reading (JI-11, JI-7; strategy 1.5 "provider fields first"; INTL note 4.6)
CHANGE: server/src/features/feed/items.ts builds the sponsorship badges today only from RAJob.sponsorship with a posting quote (76-78), shown to users who need sponsorship. MKT-3C added sponsorshipSource and lets a provider's flag fill sponsorship when no quote exists. Rule for every surface: (a) sponsorship with a non-empty sponsorshipEvidence -> the existing quoted badge, unchanged; (b) sponsorship 'offered' with sponsorshipSource 'provider:<id>' and no quote -> a different badge kind 'sponsorship_provider' whose label says it is the provider's reading and names the provider through the source registry's display name (for example 'Active Jobs DB lists visa sponsorship'), with no quote and never the wording of (a); (c) 'not_offered' from a provider alone -> no badge (a negative needs the posting's words, as today); (d) anything else -> no badge. The same rule in server/src/features/jobs/detail/view.ts for the job page's requirement lines. Company-level history (LCA, USCIS, the UK register: MKT-5G) is a company fact with year, count and source and is never turned into a job-level badge. Add the badge kind to server/src/features/feed/contract.ts; the label text is produced by the web from the kind and the provider name (string in i18n/staging/jobDetail.en.json; the card reuses it).

TESTS: server/src/features/feed/items.test.ts (the four cases), server/src/features/jobs/detail/detail.test.ts (view lines).

bundles.title: New public sources: USAJobs and 事求人, and the source register document
items:
[P1] USAJobs adapter: daily, structured pay and the real close date; disabled without a key (JI-9; strategy 1.2 tier 3, 7 item 3; INTL note 4.2, 6.4)
CHANGE: New server/src/features/jobs/sources/usaJobs.ts: JobSourceAdapter provider 'usajobs' (declared in MKT-1C), kind 'cursor', markets ['intl'], sourceBoards ['usajobs'], costModel 'free', supportsCountry US only. isEnabled = USAJOBS_API_KEY and USAJOBS_USER_AGENT_EMAIL are both set and USAJOBS_DISABLED is not true; export usaJobsStatus(env) -> { enabled } | { enabled: false, reason: 'no_key' | 'disabled' } for the source registry. Request: GET https://data.usajobs.gov/api/Search with DatePosted=1 (7 on the first run, when the cursor is empty), ResultsPerPage=500 and Page=n, with the request headers the official API reference requires (the issued key and the contact e-mail the key was requested with; confirm the header names against https://developer.usajobs.gov/api-reference/get-api-search before coding and cite the doc date in the file header). The cursor is JSON { v: 1, day: 'YYYY-MM-DD', page, firstRunDone }: one page per fetch, exhausted false while a full page came back, then nothing until the next UTC day. Mapping from each search result item (field names from the API reference; the fixture is the documented sample trimmed to two items): externalId 'usajobs:<control number>'; title; company = the hiring organisation / department name; applyUrl = the item's apply URI, else its position URI on usajobs.gov; locations as listed (country US); pay: the remuneration range (minimum, maximum, rate interval code -> year / hour / other periods as documented) in USD as stated; postedAt = publication start date; expiresAt = ApplicationCloseDate (a stated deadline: binding per MKT-3C, the row is archived after it); employmentType from the position schedule; description = the summary and qualification text the search result carries. Eligibility is told honestly: the hiring path (open to the public / federal employees only / veterans …) is stored as a market tag 'usajobs_hiring_path' with the item's own wording as the quote; citizenshipRequired is set true only when the item itself states a citizenship requirement, never by assumption. No applicant counts. Register in server/src/features/jobs/sources/register.ts next to tw_open_data.
ACCEPT: The 'Accepted when' of JI-9: without a key the adapter reports disabled with reason no_key and fetches nothing; with fixtures it maps the pay range (min, max, period, USD) and the close date into expiresAt; the first run asks for 7 days and later runs for 1; a 500-item page answers exhausted false and the next fetch asks for page 2; a federal-employees-only posting carries the hiring-path tag with its quote.
TESTS: server/src/features/jobs/sources/usaJobs.test.ts with server/src/features/jobs/sources/__fixtures__/usajobs/search.json and an injected fetch: status, request parameters and headers (names only, the key value never asserted in output), mapping, paging, daily cadence.
FILES: server/src/features/jobs/sources/usaJobs.ts (new), server/src/features/jobs/sources/usaJobs.test.ts (new), server/src/features/jobs/sources/__fixtures__/usajobs/search.json (new), server/src/features/jobs/sources/register.ts

[P1] 事求人 adapter (public-sector vacancies) without any contact field (JT-9; strategy 1.3; TW note 3.2)
CHANGE: New server/src/features/jobs/sources/twGovJobs.ts: JobSourceAdapter provider 'tw_gov_jobs' (declared in MKT-1C), kind 'cursor', markets ['intl'], sourceBoards ['tw_gov_jobs'], costModel 'free', supportsCountry TW. Dataset 7229 (行政院人事行政總處事求人機關徵才資料, OGDL v1, refreshed at least daily): one XML file, GET https://web3.dgpa.gov.tw/WANT03FRONT/AP/WANTF00003.aspx?GETJOB=Y (about 6.4 MB, about 2,100 rows on 2026-10-11): https only, redirect 'error', 30 s timeout, 20 MB cap, User-Agent sourceUserAgent('intl', env); enabled unless TW_GOV_JOBS_ENABLED is false; URL override TW_GOV_JOBS_URL. One request a day (cursor { v: 1, day }). Parse with a small tolerant element reader (flat records; no new dependency). Mapping: externalId 'dgpa:<id>' where id is the vacancy's own id parameter in VIEW_URL's query string when one is recognisable, else the first 16 hex characters of sha1(VIEW_URL) (stable for as long as the page URL is); a row without VIEW_URL is skipped and counted (no_stable_id); title = TITLE; company = ORG_NAME; applyUrl = sourceUrl = VIEW_URL; location = WORK_PLACE_TYPE (for example '10-臺北市': strip the numeric prefix) plus WORK_ADDRESS, country TW; description = WORK_ITEM and WORK_QUALITY (qualifications; pay points often appear there as text and are left to the normal pay-text reader, never turned into a figure by this adapter); postedAt = DATE_FROM and expiresAt = DATE_TO, both Republic-of-China dates (1151231 = 2026-12-31: year + 1911), end of day Taipei time for the deadline; headcount from NUMBER_OF when numeric. PERSON_KIND decides who may apply: 約僱人員, 聘用人員 and 其他人員 are open to the public and are ingested; 一般人員 posts are transfers for serving civil servants (商調) and are skipped and counted (tw_gov_internal_transfer) unless TW_GOV_JOBS_INCLUDE_TRANSFERS is true, in which case they carry a market tag with the PERSON_KIND text as its quote. NEVER read into any field, log or fixture: VITAE_EMAIL and CONTACT_METHOD (officials' names, e-mail addresses and phone numbers; the licence does not cover third-party privacy): the reader drops both elements before a record object is built. Closure: the file is a complete listing, so ids of our open rows absent from today's file are returned as closedExternalIds ('source_removed'). The OGDL attribution for these rows is already produced by MKT-3E's hook table (key tw_gov_jobs) and rendered by the Taiwan card. Register in server/src/features/jobs/sources/register.ts.
ACCEPT: The 'Accepted when' of JT-9: rows link to VIEW_URL and no e-mail address or phone number is stored (a test scans every produced input and the fixture file for '@' and digit runs taken from the contact fields); DATE_TO 1151231 becomes 2026-12-31 Taipei end of day; a 一般人員 row is skipped and counted by default; a row missing from the next file is closed; the card of such a row shows the 人事行政總處 attribution sentence.
TESTS: server/src/features/jobs/sources/twGovJobs.test.ts with server/src/features/jobs/sources/__fixtures__/twgov/sample.xml (three records hand-built from the documented field list, with obviously fake values in the two contact elements to prove they are dropped): mapping, ROC dates, PERSON_KIND rule, privacy scan, closure, kill switch.
FILES: server/src/features/jobs/sources/twGovJobs.ts (new), server/src/features/jobs/sources/twGovJobs.test.ts (new), server/src/features/jobs/sources/__fixtures__/twgov/sample.xml (new), server/src/features/jobs/sources/register.ts

[P1] Source register: one row per provider with plan, quota, permitted surfaces, attribution, retention and the date read (JI-12; strategy 1.6, 7 item 15; INTL note 8.2 S8)
CHANGE: New docs/job-search/SOURCE_REGISTER.md. One table row per provider id that can write a job row: ats_public (per ATS: Greenhouse, Lever incl. EU, Ashby, SmartRecruiters, Workable, Recruitee, Personio, 北森 behind its flag), bank_robohire, bank_gohire, activejobs (search and feed), jsearch, tw_open_data, tw_gov_jobs, usajobs, user_import. Columns: provider id; what it is and who publishes it; plan and quota as known on the date read (for example Active Jobs DB: BASIC, 25 requests and 250 jobs a month on 2026-10-11; JSearch: 10,000 requests a month); permitted surfaces (signed-in users / public indexable pages / partner API), each with its basis: OGDL v1 permits public redisplay for the two Taiwan datasets; Fantastic.jobs terms 9.1-9.2 allow showing matched jobs to our own users and public pages are an open written question; JSearch redisplay rights are unresolved, so signed-in only; employer boards: signed-in, public display awaits counsel; USAJobs: official API; required attribution text (the two OGDL sentences verbatim; 'never LinkedIn branding' for aggregators); retention on termination when the terms state one, otherwise 'not stated'; primary URL of the terms; date read; owner decision pending. Take every fact from the research notes (JOB_SOURCES_INTL, _TW, _CN and MARKET_STRATEGY 1.6, 7) and write 'not stated' or 'unresolved' where they say so: no licence, price or quota may be invented (D3). A second section lists the forbidden sources of strategy 1.6 with the reason, and a third the env switch per source. State which providers are candidates for PUBLIC_DISPLAY_PROVIDERS (tw_open_data and usajobs are the recommended first entries) and that the default stays empty until the owner decides. server/src/features/jobs/sources/sourceRegister.test.ts parses the table and fails when a provider id in PROVIDER_META (server/src/features/jobs/normalize/source.ts) has no row, when a row lacks a date read, or when a forbidden host of 1.6 appears as a provider.
ACCEPT: The 'Accepted when' of JI-12: one row per provider with plan, quota, permitted surfaces, attribution, retention and date read; the test passes and fails when a new provider id is added without a row; the document names no source the strategy forbids as usable and invents no number (every figure is traceable to a research note section, cited in the row).
TESTS: server/src/features/jobs/sources/sourceRegister.test.ts (new; reads the Markdown file from disk, no network).
FILES: docs/job-search/SOURCE_REGISTER.md (new), server/src/features/jobs/sources/sourceRegister.test.ts (new)
env: USAJOBS_API_KEY: free key from developer.usajobs.gov; without it the adapter is disabled (unset)
USAJOBS_USER_AGENT_EMAIL: the contact e-mail the key was issued to, sent as the API requires (unset)
USAJOBS_DISABLED: true turns the adapter off (false)
TW_GOV_JOBS_ENABLED: false turns the 事求人 adapter off (on)
TW_GOV_JOBS_URL: dataset URL override (the documented endpoint)
TW_GOV_JOBS_INCLUDE_TRANSFERS: true also ingests 一般人員 transfer posts, tagged (false)

bundles.title: GoHire bank over the syndication endpoint: hardened HTTP adapter, mirror read for live cross-bank search, the contract for the second repository
items:
[P0] Syndication wire contract, validated before anything is logged or stored (JC-2, JC-3 this repository's side; strategy 1.4 tier 1, 8 "GoHire bank transport"; CN note 2.3 option B)
CHANGE: The parity wave (PAR-7) added an HTTPS reader for the GoHire bank and a first variant for GOHIRE_SYNDICATION_URL. This item fixes the contract in code so the endpoint in the GoHire backend (second repository, JC-3) and this adapter are built against the same shape. New server/src/features/jobs/ingest/adapters/syndication.ts: zod schemas SyndicatedJobSchema = exactly the columns of BANK_SYNC_SELECT (server/src/features/jobs/ingest/adapters/bank.ts 33-57: id, status, publishedAt, updatedAt, title, description, qualifications, hardRequirements, niceToHave, benefits, location, locations, workType, employmentType, experienceLevel, salaryMin, salaryMax, salaryCurrency, salaryPeriod, salaryText, companyName, requiredKeywordSet, company { id, name, logoUrl, website, industry, size, headcount, founded }) plus the two fields the parity wave reads (education, headcount) plus employerVerified: boolean, syndicationConsentAt: ISO string | null, validFrom: ISO string | null, validUntil: ISO string | null; SyndicationPageSchema = { items: SyndicatedJob[], tombstones: Array<{ id: string, updatedAt: ISO string, reason?: string }>, nextCursor: string | null, hasMore: boolean }. Parsing strips every unknown key (recruiter notes, evaluation rules, AI caches, tenant data can never pass, whatever the server sends) and a page that fails validation is an error result, not a partial write. Export toBankSyncRow(job) so the existing mapping (inputFromBankSyncRow, 142-186) and quality gates (isSyncableBankJob, the named-employer rule, the parity wave's bank_unpublished / bank_no_company / bank_test_posting tallies) are reused unchanged. Nothing in a validation error message quotes the payload.
ACCEPT: A page with an extra field 'notes' on a job parses and the field is absent from the result and from every log line (logger spy); a page missing 'items' or with a non-ISO updatedAt is rejected as one error; toBankSyncRow output passes isSyncableBankJob for an open published job and the same inputFromBankSyncRow mapping as a database row with the same values (deep-equal test).
TESTS: server/src/features/jobs/ingest/adapters/syndication.test.ts: schema acceptance and rejection table, key stripping, equivalence with the database reader's row shape.
FILES: server/src/features/jobs/ingest/adapters/syndication.ts (new), server/src/features/jobs/ingest/adapters/syndication.test.ts (new), server/src/features/jobs/ingest/adapters/bank.ts

[P0] HTTP variant of the bank adapter: cursor sync with tombstones, verified-employer and consent fields, validity, TLS only (JC-2; strategy 1.4 tier 1, 1.5; CN note 2.3, 5.2)
CHANGE: server/src/features/jobs/ingest/adapters/bank.ts: behind the BankPageReader seam (line 189) the syndication reader becomes the transport whenever GOHIRE_SYNDICATION_URL is set (it wins over the parity wave's list reader and over the database transport; GOHIRE_BANK_TRANSPORT=off still disables the bank). Request: GET <GOHIRE_SYNDICATION_URL>?cursor=<updatedAt ISO|id>&limit=<INGEST_BANK_PAGE, default 200>; the URL must be https (localhost and 127.0.0.1 are exempt for tests and a dev tunnel; anything else answers error 'syndication_url_not_https' and no request is made); authentication with the service key GOHIRE_SYNDICATION_KEY, falling back to GOHIRE_API_KEY, in the same header the existing GoHire client of this repo sends (server/src/services/GoHireResumeParseService.ts); 20 s timeout; response cap 5 MB; redirect 'error'. Result mapping to SourceFetchResult: items -> jobs through toBankSyncRow and the existing gates; tombstones -> closedExternalIds (closeReason 'bank_closed', the default; the upsert revives a job the bank publishes again); cursor = nextCursor, rejected with error 'cursor_regressed' when it sorts before the cursor sent; exhausted = !hasMore. Fields: employerVerified true is the only thing that lets a row carry 企业直招 (and only when it is not an agency: unchanged rule); syndicationConsentAt non-null sets publicDisplay (the consent to syndicate, OPS-A4) and null keeps the row for signed-in users only; validUntil -> ProviderJobInput.expiresAt (MKT-3C honours a stated validity for bank rows; mainland naive times are UTC+8 but this endpoint must send ISO with an offset, so a zone-less value is treated as UTC+8 and counted in a tally). Rows are market cn, sourceBoard 'gohire', priority 3 (MKT-3C), apply URL = the GoHire page (synthesizeApplyUrl). A recruiter test posting (an empty company name, or a title containing 测试) is skipped and counted on every transport (strategy 1.4; JC-2 'test postings filtered'): reuse the parity wave's gate, and if it sits inside the list reader only, move it into the shared row gate of bank.ts so the syndication and the database readers apply it too. server/src/roboapply/v2/lib/raBankClients.ts isBankEnabled (43-54): reports the bank enabled with transport 'syndication' when the URL and a key are set, without requiring any database URL; the TLS rule for the database transport (bankTlsSatisfied, 68-79) is untouched. Never throws; an error string carries the status code and a short reason, never the URL's query, the key or a body excerpt.
ACCEPT: The 'Accepted when' of JC-2: with GOHIRE_SYNDICATION_URL pointing at an in-process stub server (node:http on 127.0.0.1) a cursor sync over two pages upserts the rows into market cn and a tombstone archives one stored row as bank_closed; a job with employerVerified true and no agency flag may carry 企业直招 and one without may not; a job without syndicationConsentAt has publicDisplay false; validUntil becomes expiresAt; a syndicated item with an empty company or a title containing 测试 is not written and is counted in the run tally; an http:// URL on a public host is refused without a request; a regressed cursor, a 401 and a 6 MB body each give an error result and write nothing; with the variable unset the parity wave's transports behave exactly as before (their tests are unchanged).
TESTS: server/src/features/jobs/ingest/adapters/adapters.test.ts and a new section in syndication.test.ts using the stub server or an injected fetch (no external network): paging, tombstones, field effects, the refusal cases, key and URL never logged (logger spy).
FILES: server/src/features/jobs/ingest/adapters/bank.ts, server/src/features/jobs/ingest/adapters/syndication.ts, server/src/features/jobs/ingest/adapters/syndication.test.ts, server/src/features/jobs/ingest/adapters/adapters.test.ts, server/src/roboapply/v2/lib/raBankClients.ts

[P1] Live cross-bank search reads the synced mirror whenever the GoHire bank is reached over HTTP (JC-2; strategy 1.4; CN note 2.1, 2.3)
CHANGE: server/src/roboapply/v2/lib/raBankProviders.ts and server/src/roboapply/v2/services/RACrossBankSearchService.ts run a live findMany on the recruiter database (OR over title, description and tag sets, status open, fresh). With the HTTP transports there is no database client for GoHire, and none must ever be opened in plaintext. Rule: when the GoHire transport is 'api' or 'syndication' (isBankEnabled reports it), the GoHire leg of a cross-bank search queries our own RAJob mirror instead: market 'cn', sourceBoard 'gohire', visibility 'public', archivedAt null, isCanonical true, the same title / description / skills predicates, the same freshness bound, mapped to the bank-job shape the matcher expects (id = RAJob.externalId, the recruiter Job.id). The parity wave did this 'when no database client exists'; make it depend on the transport, so a configured but non-TLS database URL can never be chosen for search while sync runs over HTTP, and add the mirror's sync age (the newest lastSeenAt of gohire rows) to the search telemetry so a stale mirror is visible. The RoboHire leg and the database transport are unchanged. Never throws (existing contract).
ACCEPT: With transport syndication a GoHire cross-bank search returns rows from the mirror, makes zero calls to getBankClient('gohire') (spy) and zero HTTP calls; with the database transport it queries the bank as before; an empty mirror returns an empty list, not an error; the result items carry the recruiter job id so materialisation keys stay the same.
TESTS: server/src/roboapply/v2/lib/raBankProviders.test.ts and server/src/roboapply/v2/services/RACrossBankSearchService.test.ts with fake clients: transport switch, no client opened, mapping.
FILES: server/src/roboapply/v2/lib/raBankProviders.ts, server/src/roboapply/v2/lib/raBankProviders.test.ts, server/src/roboapply/v2/services/RACrossBankSearchService.ts, server/src/roboapply/v2/services/RACrossBankSearchService.test.ts, server/src/roboapply/v2/lib/raBankClients.ts

[P1] The endpoint contract and work package for the GoHire backend, and a read-only probe the owner can run (JC-3 this repository's side; strategy 7 items 9-10)
CHANGE: New docs/jobright-clone/market/GOHIRE_SYNDICATION.md, written for the engineer who builds the route in the RoboHire / GoHire backend (the second repository; no code of that repository is changed from here): route GET /api/v1/syndication/jobs?cursor=<updatedAt|id>&limit<=200 on the host that already serves valid TLS (api.gohire.top); authentication by a service key with a new scope limited to this route (an ordinary user key lists only that user's jobs and must not work here); response exactly SyndicationPageSchema of the previous items (field list copied from the schema file, which stays the source of truth); semantics: only jobs that are open AND published, ordered by (updatedAt, id), tombstones for jobs that were closed, unpublished, re-drafted or lost consent since the cursor, employerVerified from the verified-employer record (re-verified at least every six months per the five-ministry notice), syndicationConsentAt from the employer's recorded consent, validUntil from the posting's validity period, timestamps in ISO 8601 with offset; never internal notes, evaluation rules, candidate or recruiter personal data; rate: one request every few seconds is enough (cursor sync every 10 minutes); errors as JSON with a code. Add the acceptance list for the owner's side (the route returns the agreed columns over TLS with a scoped key; test postings such as titles containing 测试 or an empty company are not published), the schema additions the bank needs (employerVerified, syndicationConsentAt, validity), and the env to set here (GOHIRE_SYNDICATION_URL, GOHIRE_SYNDICATION_KEY). Also record what this repo falls back to until the route exists (the parity wave's list reader, which sees only the jobs the service key's user may see). New scripts/gohire-syndication-probe.mjs (run by the owner, never by CI): one GET of the first page with the configured URL and key, validated with the same schema (import the built schema or a small copy kept in sync by a test), printing only counts (items, tombstones, how many verified, how many with consent, how many with validity), the page's cursor and schema problems by field name; it prints no job text, no company name and no key.
ACCEPT: The document lets an engineer with no other context build the route (every field, the ordering, tombstone rules, auth scope and error shape are stated) and names the owner steps of strategy 7 items 9-10; the probe run against the stub server prints counts and exits 0, prints schema problems and exits 1 for a bad page, and its output contains no value from the payload other than counts and the cursor (test).
TESTS: A unit test for the probe's summariser inside server/src/features/jobs/ingest/adapters/syndication.test.ts (pure function imported from the script or shared module; no network).

bundles.title: Taiwan extras: pay-rule note from config, district level and shift pattern with their filters, provenance and helper text
items:
[P1] The pay-disclosure note takes its threshold, source link and as-of date from AppConfig (JT-6; strategy 1.3, 1.5 pay; TW note 4)
CHANGE: The note that explains why a 面議 posting may omit pay names the statutory threshold, and the Ministry of Labor has announced a change from NT$40,000 to about NT$50,000 (not passed, no date). New server/src/features/tw/payRule.ts, modelled on server/src/platform/billing/fxReference.ts: AppConfig key 'tw.payRule.v1' with value { thresholdTwd: number, lawLabel: string, sourceUrl: string, asOf: 'YYYY-MM-DD', updatedAt, updatedBy }; when the row is missing the default is the law in force as read on 2026-10-11: { thresholdTwd: 40000, lawLabel: '就業服務法第5條第2項第6款', sourceUrl: 'https://law.moj.gov.tw/LawClass/LawSingle.aspx?pcode=N0090001&flno=5', asOf: '2026-10-11' }. readTwPayRule(db) and saveTwPayRule(db, input, adminId) with validation (threshold 10,000-200,000 in whole thousands, https source URL, a real date not in the future). Routes in a new server/src/features/tw/routes.ts mounted from server/src/features/index.ts: GET /api/v1/roboapply/tw/pay-rule (any signed-in or public page of the intl brand; cache 5 minutes) and PUT /api/v1/roboapply/admin/tw/pay-rule (admin; audit-logged through the existing admin audit helper); both answer 404 feature_disabled on GoApply. The note keeps saying what it says today: it explains the rule and never states or implies that THIS job pays the threshold; the threshold is never shown as a job's pay, never used as a filter value and never written to a job row (MKT-1C already made the parser threshold-agnostic).

CHANGE: Live strings such as 新竹縣竹北市, 苗栗縣竹南鎮, 台中市西屯區 and 臺南市善化區 resolve to the right city today but the district is discarded. server/src/features/jobs/geo/parseLocation.ts (parseLocation, line 153): ParsedLocation gains district: string | null, filled for country TW from findTwDistrict (MKT-3E's server/src/features/jobs/geo/twDistricts.ts: county + 鄉鎮市區, both 台 and 臺 forms; '不限' means the whole county and gives no district); other countries always null. bundles.title: Sponsorship facts with source and date: USCIS H-1B Employer Data Hub and the UK Register of Licensed Sponsors next to the DOL LCA loader
items:
[P1] USCIS H-1B Employer Data Hub loader (JI-11; strategy 9.4; INTL note 4.6, 8.2 S4)
CHANGE: The DOL LCA loader exists and stays as it is (server/src/features/jobs/data/lca.ts, importLca.ts, table RAH1bEmployerStat; its tests must still pass). Add beside it server/src/features/jobs/data/uscis.ts and importUscis.ts for the USCIS H-1B Employer Data Hub export (one CSV per fiscal year, public record). The research did not open the official page, so the importer maps columns by header name and fails loudly on a file whose header it does not recognise: required headers are the fiscal year, the employer (petitioner) name and the four counts (initial approvals, initial denials, continuing approvals, continuing denials); confirm the exact header spellings against a file downloaded from the hub and record them, with the download URL and date, in the module header and in a three-row fixture built from that header (employer names in the fixture are invented placeholders such as 'EXAMPLE EMPLOYER LLC'; no real row is committed). parseUscisRow -> { fiscalYear, employerName, approvals = initial + continuing approvals, denials = initial + continuing denials }; aggregate per normalised employer name (the same normalizeCompanyName the LCA loader uses) and fiscal year; upsert into the new table RASponsorRegisterEntry (M0 schema bundle) with source 'uscis_h1b_hub', country 'US', period 'FY<year>', sourceFile = the file name, sourceUrl = the hub URL, asOf = the file's publication date given on the command line. CLI: tsx server/src/features/jobs/data/importUscis.ts <file.csv> --as-of YYYY-MM-DD [--dry-run], streaming with csv-parse; it is run by the owner or ops against the chosen database, never by a work-package agent and never in CI. No government file is committed to the repo.
ACCEPT: The fixture file imports in dry-run mode into three aggregated rows with the right sums; a file with an unknown header fails with a message naming the missing column and writes nothing; running the import twice leaves one row per (source, employer, period); the existing LCA tests pass unchanged.
TESTS: server/src/features/jobs/data/uscis.test.ts (new) with server/src/features/jobs/data/__fixtures__/uscis.sample.csv: header detection, parsing, aggregation, idempotent upsert through a fake db.
FILES: server/src/features/jobs/data/uscis.ts (new), server/src/features/jobs/data/importUscis.ts (new), server/src/features/jobs/data/uscis.test.ts (new), server/src/features/jobs/data/__fixtures__/uscis.sample.csv (new), server/src/features/jobs/data/index.ts

[P1] UK Register of Licensed Sponsors (Workers) loader (JI-11; INTL note 4.6)
CHANGE: New server/src/features/jobs/data/ukSponsors.ts and importUkSponsors.ts for the Home Office register published on gov.uk as a CSV (organisation name, town / city, county, type and rating, route). Same rules as the USCIS loader: map by header name, fail loudly on an unknown header, confirm the header spellings against a downloaded file and record them with the URL and date; fixture rows are invented placeholders. One organisation appears on several lines (one per route): aggregate per normalised organisation name into one RASponsorRegisterEntry with source 'uk_sponsor_register', country 'GB', period '' (the register is a current list, not a yearly count), town, rating and routes[] (distinct, in file order), approvals and denials null, sourceFile, sourceUrl, asOf = the register's publication date from the command line. Each import replaces the previous snapshot of this source inside one transaction (delete rows of the source whose asOf is older, then upsert), so an organisation that left the register no longer shows as a licensed sponsor. CLI: tsx server/src/features/jobs/data/importUkSponsors.ts <file.csv> --as-of YYYY-MM-DD [--dry-run]; owner-run only.
ACCEPT: A fixture with one organisation on two routes imports as one row with both routes; an organisation missing from a newer file is gone after that import; an unknown header fails without writing; dry-run writes nothing.
TESTS: server/src/features/jobs/data/ukSponsors.test.ts (new) with server/src/features/jobs/data/__fixtures__/uk-sponsors.sample.csv.
FILES: server/src/features/jobs/data/ukSponsors.ts (new), server/src/features/jobs/data/importUkSponsors.ts (new), server/src/features/jobs/data/ukSponsors.test.ts (new), server/src/features/jobs/data/__fixtures__/uk-sponsors.sample.csv (new), server/src/features/jobs/data/index.ts

[P1] Company sponsorship facts API: every number with its year, source and date (JI-11; strategy D3)
CHANGE: New server/src/features/jobs/companies/sponsorship/ (service.ts, contract.ts, sponsorship.test.ts) and a route in server/src/features/jobs/companies/routes.ts next to '/:id/h1b' (68-73): GET /api/v1/roboapply/companies/:id/sponsorship (RoboApply only, the existing h1bHistory flag; GoApply answers feature_disabled because none of these registers concerns the mainland). Response: { facts: SponsorshipFact[], disclaimer }, where a fact is one of: { kind: 'dol_lca', fiscalYear, certifiedCount, source: { name: 'US Department of Labor, LCA disclosure data', url: DOL_LCA_URL (service.ts 387), sourceFile, asOf } } (from RAH1bEmployerStat, the existing data), { kind: 'uscis_h1b_hub', fiscalYear, approvals, denials, source: { name, url, sourceFile, asOf } }, { kind: 'uk_sponsor_register', town, rating, routes, source: { name, url, sourceFile, asOf } }. Match the company to register rows by the same normalised name used for RAH1bEmployerStat (exact match of nameNormalized in the company's market; no fuzzy match, and when the company has no row the list is simply empty: nothing is inferred). Keep at most the five most recent fiscal years per US source. The disclaimer (English source text in the contract, translated by the web) says that past filings or a licence do not mean this employer will sponsor this role. The existing /h1b route stays for its current consumers. Web wrapper lib/api/companyFacts.ts. Add jobDataAttributions entries (server/src/features/jobs/data/index.ts) for the two new datasets so /legal lists them with their publishers.
ACCEPT: The first half of JI-11's 'Accepted when': a company with LCA and USCIS rows returns facts that each show year, count and source (name, URL, file, as-of date); a UK-registered company returns one fact with rating and routes; a company with no rows returns an empty list and the disclaimer; the route is disabled on GoApply; the existing LCA and /h1b tests pass unchanged.
TESTS: server/src/features/jobs/companies/sponsorship/sponsorship.test.ts (new) with a fake db: assembly per source, year cap, empty case; server/src/features/jobs/companies/companies.test.ts: route mount and flags.
FILES: server/src/features/jobs/companies/sponsorship/service.ts (new), server/src/features/jobs/companies/sponsorship/contract.ts (new), server/src/features/jobs/companies/sponsorship/sponsorship.test.ts (new), server/src/features/jobs/companies/routes.ts, server/src/features/jobs/companies/index.ts, server/src/features/jobs/companies/companies.test.ts, server/src/features/jobs/data/index.ts, lib/api/companyFacts.ts (new)

[P1] The job page shows the company's sponsorship facts as dated facts, apart from the job (JI-11; strategy 1.5; INTL note 4.6)
CHANGE: New components/features/job/SponsorshipFacts.tsx, mounted in components/features/job/JobOverview.tsx in the company section for RoboApply users whose profile says they need sponsorship in the job's country (the same condition the feed's sponsorship badges use; for everyone else the block is collapsed behind one line). It lists each fact as a sentence built from the response: '{count} H-1B labor condition applications certified in fiscal year {year}', '{approvals} H-1B petitions approved in fiscal year {year}', 'Licensed sponsor on the UK register ({rating}; {routes})', each followed by its source name as a link and 'as of {date}', then the disclaimer. It never says the job sponsors: job-level statements stay the two badge kinds of MKT-5C (the posting's quote, or the labelled provider reading). Empty list -> the block is not rendered (no 'no data' claim about the employer). Strings in a new namespace: i18n/staging/companyFacts.en.json, registered in i18n/staging/index.ts (the only edit to that file: one import and one entry).
ACCEPT: For a company with facts the block shows year, count and source for each and the disclaimer; with no facts nothing is rendered; no sentence contains 'sponsors this job' or equivalent (copy test); GoApply never renders the block; npm run check passes.
TESTS: components/features/job/sponsorshipFacts.test.tsx (new): rendering per fact kind, empty state, brand gate.
FILES: components/features/job/SponsorshipFacts.tsx (new), components/features/job/JobOverview.tsx, components/features/job/sponsorshipFacts.test.tsx (new), lib/api/companyFacts.ts, i18n/staging/companyFacts.en.json (new), i18n/staging/index.ts
schema: new model RASponsorRegisterEntry (server/prisma/schema/ra-jobs.prisma): id String @id @default(cuid()); source String /// 'uscis_h1b_hub' | 'uk_sponsor_register'; country String /// ISO alpha-2; employerNameNormalized String; employerName String; period String @default("") /// 'FY2025' for USCIS, '' for the UK register; approvals Int?; denials Int?; town String?; rating String?; routes String[] @default([]); sourceFile String; sourceUrl String; asOf DateTime; importedAt DateTime @default(now()); @@unique([source, employerNameNormalized, period]); @@index([country, employerNameNormalized])
Everything above is delivered by MKT-0 in phase M0 (see its schema array for the exact Prisma text); this bundle never edits *.prisma and never runs a push.
